data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
 



**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  




**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Sr. Manager Special Projects \& Performance role is part of the regional Chief operating office organizational structure. The role involves analyzing talabat’s business performance, preparing data\-driven insights for senior management, conducting in\-depth market analyses to unlock topline and bottomline opportunities, leading special projects, and ensuring talabat is on track to hit PnL targets. The candidate is expected to spend 50% of the time on the ground in our local markets to drive projects and work with teams on execution.
   

  

**Reporting Business Performance**
* Analyze Data: Dive into talabat’s performance metrics, identifying key trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
* Prepare Reports: Create comprehensive and insightful reports for senior management, highlighting key drivers of change and actionable insights.
* Communicate Findings: Present findings in a clear and concise manner, often translating complex data into understandable recommendations for decision\-makers.


**Conducting Analytical Deep Dives**
* Country\-Specific Analysis: Perform detailed analyses of different talabat markets, focusing on identifying turnaround opportunities, growth and profitability areas.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with various departments to understand and address cross\-functional issues impacting business performance.
* Strategy Development: Develop and recommend strategies based on analysis to improve overall performance and achieve business objectives.


**Special Projects**
* Launching new products: Develop business use cases with innovative ideas and bring them to life by working on their implementation, ensuring they align with strategic goals and add value to the business.
* Leading country turnaround projects to identify key gaps in the markets and working alongside local markets on execution


**Driving AI Efforts**
* Leading AI efforts across all performance teams to identify new use cases to enhance productivity


**PnL Management**
* Budgeting: Collaborate with local teams to develop talabat’s yearly budget, setting growth and profitability goals.
* PnL management: Ensure that budgets are adhered to consistently across the organization and proactively identify and pursue opportunities to exceed financial targets and enhance overall profitability.


**Qualifications**
**What did we order?**
* Thought Leadership ability to drive innovation and impact
* Analytical Mindset strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on data\-driven decisions
* Curiosity, eagerness to learn, explore, and drive creative solutions.
* Stakeholder Management skilled in engaging and managing diverse stakeholder interests
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration effective in working with teams across different functions to achieve common goals
* Experience with financial modelling and PnL analysis strongly preferred
* Experience using SQL, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau strongly preferred

**Why qlub**
 The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.
   

  

 From Pay\-at\-Table and Digital Menus to Order\-and\-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.
   

  

 We're a fast\-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e\& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.
   

  

**The role**
 qlub is scaling fast across markets worldwide, and we look for people who take real ownership of their work. As our next Operations Executive, you'll help drive our growth in Partner Success building, shipping, and delivering results from day one.
   

  

 You'll work closely with operators and partners to turn frictionless payments into real growth for restaurants. You'll also play a key role in ensuring new restaurant partners have a smooth onboarding journey and that existing partners maximize their adoption of Qlub solutions. From training restaurant staff to troubleshooting issues and driving re\-engagement, you'll be at the frontlines of ensuring our partners and their customers have the best possible experience.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast\-moving, build\-from\-scratch environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Onboarding \& Setup**
* Support the full onboarding journey of new restaurant partners, including account setup and system configurations when required
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Tech, Content, Procurement, and Account Management, to ensure a seamless go\-live experience
* Ensure all onboarding activities are completed accurately and on time to facilitate successful launches


**Training \& Enablement**
* Conduct in\-person and remote training sessions for restaurant staff to ensure smooth adoption of Qlub's solutions
* Organize and deliver retraining sessions when needed to address knowledge gaps and reinforce best practices
* Act as a trusted advisor for restaurant teams, helping them maximize the value of Qlub's products and features


**Performance Monitoring \& Adoption**
* Monitor partner performance metrics, including QR adoption rates and transaction trends, to proactively identify opportunities and potential issues
* Troubleshoot operational and technical challenges in collaboration with Account Management, Customer Support, and Tech teams
* Implement corrective actions and provide ongoing enablement to drive long\-term adoption and engagement
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational checks to ensure teams remain confident and effective in using Qlub solutions


**Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Feedback**
* Partner closely with Account Managers to share insights on partner performance and ensure timely communication with key stakeholders
* Gather feedback from restaurant partners and frontline staff to continuously improve processes, training materials, and the overall partner experience
* Collaborate with Product, Operations, and Tech teams to identify recurring challenges and contribute to scalable solutions and product enhancements


**What You’ll Own**
* Own the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new restaurant partners, ensuring a seamless setup experience and building strong partner relationships from day one
* Drive adoption and engagement for newly onboarded partners, achieving and maintaining a target Qlub adoption rate of 45% across assigned accounts
* Monitor and manage the performance of existing partner outlets, proactively identifying opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and overall partner success


**Who You Are**
* You've done this before in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by solving problems and creating exceptional experiences for restaurant partners and their customers
* You're highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail
* You enjoy working directly with customers, building relationships, and helping partners succeed


**What You'll Need**
* A valid driving license and access to a car are required
* 0–2 years of experience in customer onboarding, account management, training, customer success, or a similar client\-facing role
* Proven ability to deliver training sessions and engage diverse audiences effectively
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot issues and coordinate solutions quickly across multiple stakeholders
* Proficiency with digital tools such as CRM systems, Google Workspace, Excel, and Google Sheets
* Fluency in English is a must
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly


**Nice to have**
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, SaaS, or technology environments is a strong plus
* Fluency in Arabic is a plus


**What We Offer**
* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast\-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest\-growing restaurant technology companies globally


**Ready to build?** 
 Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

**Designation: Director, Strategy \& Transformation / Director CEO Office \& Transformation** 




**Location: Dubai, UAE** 




  





**About SUMWON STUDIOS** 




**SUMWON STUDIOS** 
 is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes
 **MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN** 
 and
 **KSTM.** 




  





 In just a few years, we have grown from start\-up to one of the fastest\-scaling brand platforms in the
 
 industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital\-first world.
 



  





 We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working.
 



  





**The Role** 




 This is not a traditional Chief of Staff role.
 



  





 The primary purpose of this position is to act as a force multiplier for the CEO and leadership team, increasing the speed, quality and effectiveness of decision making and execution across the organisation.
 



  





 You will work across every function of the business, helping shape strategy while ensuring critical initiatives are delivered. You will lead transformation programmes, drive organisational effectiveness, champion AI and automation adoption, and take ownership of high\-impact strategic projects.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with relentless execution. We are less interested in career consultants and more interested in operators who have helped build, scale and transform businesses from the inside.
 



  





 This role is designed for someone with the ambition and capability to become a future GM, COO or CEO.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 CEO Office \& Strategic Execution
 


* Partner directly with the CEO on the company's most important priorities.
* Translate strategy into clear action plans, accountability and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives across all functions.
* Monitor business performance and identify opportunities, risks and bottlenecks.
* Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO.
* Independently lead major initiatives with minimal direction.



 AI, Technology \& Business Transformation
 


* Lead the identification, prioritisation and implementation of AI, automation and technology initiatives across the business.
* Partner with functional leaders to redesign processes and operating models using technology.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, speed, quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage.
* Establish a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous improvement.



 Organisational Effectiveness
 


* Drive company\-wide OKRs, governance and accountability frameworks.
* Improve decision\-making processes and organisational operating rhythms.
* Help ensure the business scales effectively as teams, brands and markets grow.
* Support leadership teams in defining structures, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Remove complexity and improve cross\-functional collaboration.



 Strategic Projects \& Corporate Development
 


* Lead high\-priority projects on behalf of the CEO.
* Support acquisitions, partnerships, market expansion and new business initiatives.
* Coordinate due diligence, integration planning and execution activities.
* Develop business cases, strategic recommendations and implementation plans.



 Internal \& Corporate Communications
 


* Support company\-wide communication of strategic priorities and transformation programmes.
* Help align teams around business objectives and organisational change.
* Support investor, board, media and external stakeholder communications where required.
* Prepare executive presentations, board materials and strategic updates.



 Talent \& Leadership Support
 


* Support organisational and leadership development initiatives.
* Help identify capability gaps and opportunities to strengthen the organisation.
* Work alongside senior leaders to improve team effectiveness and performance.
* Contribute to succession planning and future leadership development.



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* 5\+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, private equity, venture capital, technology, e\-commerce, consumer or high\-growth businesses.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience both advising businesses and operating within them.
* Demonstrated success leading complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical capabilities.
* Strong commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Experience driving transformation, technology or AI initiatives is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, entrepreneurial environments.
* Highly organised with exceptional execution capabilities.



  





**What we'll bring** 



* 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year
* 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Company social events
* The opportunity to work with a high\-performing team building brands at global scale



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi\-brand platform operating across global markets.

data.jd_text:
**Role Description** 




 The Regional Director – Middle East \& French West Africa will lead the establishment, expansion, and long‑term development of the company’s pharmaceutical business across the Middle East Region and Francophone West Africa. The role carries full regional P\&L responsibility and is accountable for building a scalable commercial platform capable of delivering sustainable growth across multiple markets.
 



  





 The regional expansion strategy will initially focus on establishing a strong presence in Iraq, Senegal, and Ivory Coast, followed by expansion into selected non\-GCC Middle Eastern markets and key Frontier and West African (FWA) markets. Subsequently, the strategy will extend to GCC countries to further strengthen the company's regional footprint.
 



  





 This position represents a senior regional leadership role responsible for developing the company’s commercial footprint, building high‑performing country teams, establishing strong distributor and stakeholder relationships and delivering consistent financial and operational performance across the region.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic leadership with hands‑on execution capability and an entrepreneurial mindset suited to building a regional business in the region.
 



  





**Governance and Reporting Structure** 




 The Regional Director will report to the Group Director International Business and will be responsible for overall governance, operational leadership, and financial performance of the defined region.
 



 Key governance responsibilities include:
 


* Full regional profit and loss accountability
* Development and execution of regional business plans
* Establishment of effective governance and reporting processes
* Alignment of regional strategy with global corporate objectives
* Ensuring regulatory, financial, and operational compliance across all markets



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Regional Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement the commercial strategy for the region.
* Identify and prioritize new market entry opportunities including new countries, therapeutic segments, market segments, and product opportunities.
* Develop multi‑year regional growth plans including revenue targets, portfolio expansion, and market penetration strategies.
* Assess regulatory environments and competitive landscapes across the region.



  





**Market Entry and Expansion** 



* Lead the planning and execution of country launches across priority markets.
* Establish commercial operations in new markets including distributor and promotional agency partnerships, commercial infrastructure, and local teams.
* Expand operations beyond the initial markets of Iraq, Senegal and Ivory Coast, into other regional markets.
* Drive early market entry and rapid product launch strategies.



  





**Regulatory and Market Access Acceleration** 



* Assess regulatory environments across target markets.
* Devise and implement strategies and action plans to accelerate regulatory processes.
* Ensure early market entry and rapid new product launches through proactive regulatory planning and coordination.



  





**Commercial Leadership** 



* Provide strategic and operational leadership to commercial teams across the region.
* Establish clear regional sales targets and financial performance expectations.
* Drive revenue growth and market share expansion across multiple markets.
* Ensure disciplined commercial execution at the country and front\-line levels.



  





**Organization and Team Development** 



* Recruit, develop, and lead strong country leadership and front\-line teams.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and performance across all country teams.
* Drive continuous team development and capability building.
* Promote strong collaboration across commercial, regulatory, and operational functions.



  





**Operational Leadership and Execution** 



* Maintain a hands‑on leadership approach with active involvement in on‑ground execution.
* Ensure disciplined implementation of commercial plans and market expansion initiatives.
* Work closely with distributors and local partners to ensure strong market penetration.
* Closely engage with key opinion leaders and key officers of major medical associations in the region and at the county level.



  





**Business Monitoring and Performance Management** 



* Develop and implement robust business monitoring systems across the region.
* Establish performance management frameworks to track sales, profitability, and operational metrics.
* Monitor business performance against plans and forecasts.
* Implement corrective actions where deviations from plan occur.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting systems at country, region and corporate levels.



  





**Strategic Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Build strong relationships with pharmaceutical distributors and channel partners across the region.
* Engage regulatory authorities and healthcare stakeholders across the region.
* Represent the company within relevant pharmaceutical and healthcare industry forums.
* Identify partnerships that accelerate market penetration and commercial growth.



  





**Cross‑Functional Leadership** 



* Coordinate regional activities across regulatory, supply chain, marketing, finance, and medical functions.
* Ensure alignment between regional commercial strategy and corporate priorities.
* Maintain strong operational discipline and compliance across all markets.



  





**Performance Expectations** 




 Success in the role will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:
 


* Deliver strong regional revenue growth and profitability
* Successfully launch and expand operations across priority markets
* Build high‑performing country leadership teams
* Establish a scalable commercial infrastructure across the Middle East and Francophone West Africa
* Achieve rapid market penetration and successful product launches
* Implement strong governance, reporting, and business monitoring systems



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate must have:
 


* More than 15 years of pharmaceutical commercial leadership experience, including at least 5 years in sales leadership positions
* Significant experience managing multi‑country operations in Africa
* Strong knowledge of Middle East and African healthcare markets
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding pharmaceutical businesses in emerging markets
* Strong financial and P\&L management capability

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l'autorité conjointe du Conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) et du Conseil d’administration (CA) de l'Alliance française de Dubaï, vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement. Vous pilotez, organisez, gérez et représentez l’Alliance française de Dubaï (AFD) et l’action culturelle française à Dubaï et dans les Emirats du Nord. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la mondialisation , le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'AFD dispose d'une médiathèque, une salle de cinéma/spectacle, une salle d’expositions, salles de classe. Dans ce cadre, vous devrez assurer les: \-élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l’établissement sur les plans culturel et pédagogique (programmation commune, dates d’examens, etc.). Poursuite de la diversification de l’offre de cours de langue impulsée depuis plusieurs années ; \- organisation d’événements annuels en collaboration avec les partenaires locaux ou sur fonds propres ; \- gestion des réseaux sociaux, \- développement de Culturethèque et du fonds de la médiathèque. Organisation d'événements internes. \- recherche de partenariats avec les entreprises françaises (BNP, Soc. Générale…) ou locales (émigration, douanes, municipalité, universités…) pour le développement des diplômes TCF (test de connaissance du français)/ TEF (test d'évaluation de français) et e.TEF/Delf Adulte, DELF junior et DELF Prim ; \- élaboration du budget prévisionnel de l'établissement, en accord avec le CA, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi, le budget concernant les pôles pédagogique, culturel et communication, administratif et médiathèque. \-établissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays comme avec les partenaires pédagogiques (directeurs d’établissements, départements universitaires notamment); \-Préparation et remise de rapports réguliers d’activité et compte\-rendu des réalisations et du contexte au C.A. lors des réunions trimestrielles, au conseiller culturel, à l'ambassadeur lors des réunions sur l’Ambassade et au Département (Direction générale de la Mondialisation \-DGM\-) lors de l’envoi de rapports.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Niveau Bac \+5 ou équivalent. Expérience avérée de direction d’un établissement public ou privé à l’étranger ou en France, dans des institutions culturelles ou des collectivités territoriales. La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

 The Project Management Director is responsible for managing and delivering transformation projects and other strategic initiatives under Transformation \& PMO. data.jd_text:
Join our dynamic vertical transportation design consultancy in Dubai! We are seeking a
 **Senior Document Controller** 
 to manage document control governance and CDE (Common Data Environment) for our projects. In this role, you’ll keep our projects moving by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding all technical documentation. You will own version control, transmittals, and audit trails so teams can trust they’re working from the latest approved information. This is a full\-time, office\-based position reporting to the Head of Design/PMO.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* **Govern Document Control and CDE Management:** 
 Oversee our Common Data Environment (e.g. Oracle Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360/ACC, SharePoint) and implement EDMS tools/configuration in line with project requirements and quality policies.
  
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** 
 Work closely with engineers, architects, consultants and other stakeholders to streamline documentation workflows. Provide training and guidance on document standards and best practices to project teams and partners.
  
* **Maintain Registers and Reports:** 
 Produce and update document registers, status reports and dashboards. Ensure all drawings and deliverables are properly version\-controlled, accessible and audit\-ready.
  
* **Audit Readiness:** 
 Support internal and external audits by compiling turnover dossiers, as\-built packages and ensuring compliance checks. Keep document libraries always organized and audit compliant.
  
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Develop KPIs and refine document control processes for greater traceability. Enforce ISO\-aligned documentation controls (ISO 9001/19650\) and incorporate lessons learned into improved workflows.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* **Experience:** 
 7–10\+ years of document control experience (ideally in engineering or design consultancy projects). Experience leading or mentoring a document control team is a plus.
  
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Proven proficiency with CDE/DMS platforms such as Oracle Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360 (ACC), MS SharePoint, etc. Hands\-on experience configuring document workflows and maintaining complex libraries.
  
* **Industry Background:** 
 Experience in Vertical Transportation (elevators/escalators) or related MEP disciplines is highly valued. Familiarity with reading and managing lift/escalator design drawings and specifications.
  
* **Standards \& Compliance:** 
 Good understanding of ISO 9001/19650 standards and quality management. Comfortable managing audit processes and documentation compliance.
  
* **Skills:** 
 Excellent communication, organization and leadership skills. Ability to coordinate across teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 We are a Dubai\-based
 **Vertical Transportation design consultancy**

**Company Description**
 As one of the fastest\-growing global media agency networks, Spark Foundry is not beholden to legacy. We embrace nimbleness, agility and open\-mindedness as part of our Startup Spirit. But as part of Publicis Media, we tap into a Powerhouse Soul, gaining access to first\-mover opportunities alongside market\-shaping clout, plus leading\-edge AI and technology. Together, our Startup Spirit and Powerhouse Soul allow us to innovate and iterate faster than any other agency, bringing clients a distinct competitive advantage. Our innovative experiences have been recognized by Cannes Lions, Effies, Shortys and Webbys, all delivered by best\-in\-class talent across more than 70 global offices. Spark Foundry is part of the global Publicis Media agency network, a key division of Publicis Groupe \[Euronext Paris FR0000130577, CAC 40].
   

  

**Overview**
 The IAT Director oversees the Power of One model and integrated ways of working across 5 for 72 markets. This role collaborates with global and regional leaders to customize and implement the integrated agency model across various capabilities such as media, creative, production, commerce, and social/influencer, both within Publicis and with clients and partner agencies to drive the process forward.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing client marketing initiatives holistically within Publicis to create a seamless, scalable approach that leverages market insights for continuous improvement. This role acts as the connective tissue, customizing and applying global standards and best practices, identifying successes and risks, and optimizing processes to support local, regional, and global transformation ambitions and ways of working.
   

  

 Ideal for a strategic, process\-driven individual who seeks innovative, effective ways of working, it requires understanding global vs. regional operating models, process implementation, insights management and relationship\-building with diverse stakeholders across multiple markets and capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Oversee daily orchestration, implementation, and optimization of the integrated operating model from briefing to delivery across marketing capabilities.
* Customize and manage standardized processes, address current challenges, and develop ideal workflows supported by a collaboration platform.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure seamless integration of marketing efforts.
* Manage intake of integrated and capability\-specific client briefs, including review and assignment to the appropriate internal teams for execution.
* Oversee and/or support resource management across briefs/projects, ensuring efficient allocation for marketing initiatives.
* Communicate project details, timelines, and action steps clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Track deliverables, budgets, and project overlaps, adjusting schedules and notifying teams as needed.
* Lead initiative and process feedback conversations with clients and internal teams to ensure continuous optimization of ways of working.
* Manage development of scope components, including timelines, resources, and costs.
* Drive connectivity across regions and capabilities on shared topics, surfacing insights, sharing performance results, and scalable use cases on a monthly basis.
* Partner with the Agency Orchestration team to propose solution\-led approaches aligned with global standards and best practices.
* Identify blockers and opportunities for regional leadership and clients, and develop local and regional action plans accordingly.
* Confidently manage client\-facing communication and develop presentations/documentation for senior stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will bring a minimum of 12–15 years of relevant industry experience.
   

  

 Native Arabic speakers are highly preferred.
   

  

 Proven experience managing global clients and complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership experience managing and developing high\-performing teams.

**About Art Dubai Group** 




  





 Art Dubai Group is a public\-private partnership with Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) founded in 2007, and has grown to become the most experienced cultural programming company in the Gulf. Comprising more than 30 initiatives, including the region’s leading art and design fairs and festivals, it is a provider of industry expertise to the business and government sectors, alongside year\-round commissioning and professional development programmes.
 



  





 The group’s flagship initiatives include Art Dubai, the Middle East’s pre\-eminent international art fair; Downtown Design, the region’s leading design fair with a focus on high quality and original design; Dubai Design Week, the region’s largest design festival; and Prototypes for Humanity, the world’s largest and most diverse assembly of academics addressing social and environmental challenges.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Head of Operations** 
 to lead Art Dubai Group's cross\-company functions and drive operational excellence across the organization, with end\-to\-end accountability for operational performance and team management. In this pivotal role, you will lead Operations, Finance, HR, IT, CRM, Travel Management and Office Management \- building efficient, compliant, and scalable operations that support our growing portfolio of initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the cross\-company functions spanning Operations, Finance, HR, IT, CRM, Travel Management and Office Management \- driving operational excellence and efficiency company\-wide.
* Manage financial operations in collaboration with the Finance team, including FP\&A and General Accounting.
* Drive the HR function, including recruitment, staff development, and performance management, ensuring alignment with the company’s values and objectives.
* Oversee the management of office spaces and storage facilities, ensuring they meet the company’s needs and safety standards.
* Ensure that IT infrastructure and systems are robust, secure, and up\-to\-date, aligning with operational needs.
* Oversee the CRM team and ensure the company database is continually enhanced and is secure.
* Continuously improve operational processes and implement best practices across all departments.
* Continuously review suppliers and secure cost savings through negotiation of better prices and finding synergies is costs.
* Work closely with legal advisors to ensure that all operations are compliant with local regulations and industry standards.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* 8\-10 years of experience in operations or business management, with proven leadership of cross\-functional teams, particularly Operations, Finance, IT and HR.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills; ability to prioritize multiple competing demands in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, hands\-on, and solutions\-focused approach.
* Leadership experience with the ability to manage and develop a team.
* Experience within the creative industries, events, or cultural sectors is preferred.



  





**How to apply** 




 Please share your CV via this job posting.
 



 Please note that this is an
 **on\-site** 
 role requiring office attendance
 **five days** 
 a week.

 We are building a next\-generation orchestration infrastructure platform, operating across device ecosystems, partner networks and licensed financial institutions.  The Program Manager – Strategic Execution is responsible for ensuring the company executes effectively across Product, Engineering, Operations and strategic partners. The role creates visibility, accountability and structure across the organisation whilst helping leadership establish the operating mechanisms required to scale. This is a highly cross\-functional position that works directly with leadership and influences initiatives across the company.

**Governance \& Planning** 



* Establish company planning processes.
* Coordinate roadmap planning and prioritisation activities.
* Develop KPI and OKR reporting frameworks.
* Create executive dashboards and reporting.

* Coordinate delivery across Product, Engineering and Architecture.

**Programme Management** 



* Build and maintain programme plans.

* Facilitate decision tracking and execution follow\-through.
* Support portfolio visibility and prioritisation.



**Vendor \& Partner Coordination** 



* Coordinate activities involving strategic vendors and partners.
* Track commitments, timelines and deliverables.

**EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working across Product and Engineering organisations.
* Strong planning, governance and execution capabilities.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous and fast\-changing environments.
* Experience building processes and operating frameworks from the ground up.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



  





**SUCCESS MEASURES** 




 Success in this role will be measured by:
 


* Improved visibility of company execution.
* Increased predictability of delivery outcomes.
* Effective management of risks and dependencies.
* Reduced leadership overhead associated with programme coordination.
* Establishment of scalable governance and operating processes.
* Successful delivery of strategic cross\-functional initiatives.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

data.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
data.raw_snippet: The Center for Arabic Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies,
data.jd_text:
The Center for Arabic Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
