data.raw_snippet: We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia
data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

 Reporting to the Senior Client D
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Art Director is a senior creative delivery role within M\+C Saatchi Sport \& Entertainment Middle East, responsible for leading the visual and conceptual development of sport and events campaigns across the agency's client portfolio.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Client Director, the Art Director will take briefs from strategy and account teams and translate them into compelling creative territories, campaign identities, event experiences, and activation assets that perform across all channels and touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-output role suited to a creative who understands the energy, pace, and visual language of sport and live events. You will be expected to concept and create at speed, uphold quality standards across a busy client roster, and contribute to the creative direction of the agency's most visible and complex campaigns.
   

  

 The Art Director will play an important role in shaping the agency's creative output \- working across event branding, sponsorship activations, fan engagement, social content and pitch development \- while supporting and developing the wider creative team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Creative \& Concept Development**
* Lead creative development from brief to delivery across sports and events campaigns, ensuring all work is on\-brief, on\-brand, and commercially sound.
* Translate strategic briefs into visual creative territories, mood boards, campaign frameworks and creative rationales.
* Develop and present multiple creative routes with clarity and confidence, both internally and in client\-facing settings.
* Oversee creative quality and visual consistency across all client touchpoints and across the full campaign lifecycle.


**Sports \& Events Creative**
* Design and develop event identity systems, environmental branding, wayfinding, fan zone concepts and large\-format experiential assets.
* Create campaign visual assets for major sporting events, sponsor activations, athlete partnerships and fan engagement activations.
* Produce creative across OOH, digital, social, print, broadcast and environmental formats as required by client campaigns.
* Stay ahead of design and visual communication trends in global sports marketing, live events and fan culture.


**Client \& Agency Presentations**
* Support the development of new business pitch decks, credentials presentations and agency marketing materials.
* Present creative work to clients with confidence, manage feedback clearly and see revisions through to final artwork.
* Help the agency bring creative ambition to pitches and proposals, positioning M\+C Saatchi S\&E ME as a best\-in\-class creative partner.


**Creative Team \& Production**
* Brief, direct and review work from freelance designers, illustrators, photographers and video producers.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines without compromising standards.
* Oversee artwork trafficking and file management, ensuring all assets are delivered to specification for print and digital use.
* Manage relationships with print suppliers, production studios and external creative partners where required.
* Support and mentor junior members of the creative team, helping to build capability and a culture of high standards.


**Cross\-Department Collaboration**
* Work closely across all departments to deliver integrated creative solutions.
* Collaborate with the Social Media team to ensure campaign creative works effectively across all social platforms.
* Contribute to internal creative reviews and help raise the quality of creative output across all agency accounts.


 ABOUT YOU
   

  

**Essential**
* 5\+ years of experience as an Art Director, Senior Designer or equivalent creative role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating sport and/or events work.
* Exceptional design craft with a sharp eye for typography, layout, colour and visual storytelling.
* Proven experience across multiple formats: campaign identities, event branding, social content, large\-format production and presentation design.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Strong conceptual thinking \- able to generate original ideas and develop them from sketch to final delivery.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced agency environment managing multiple client briefs simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills \- confident in client\-facing situations.
* Understanding of the GCC and Middle East market, cultural sensitivities and visual communication norms.


**Desirable**
* Proven experience on major sporting events \- rugby, football, motorsport, tennis, athletics or equivalent.
* Motion graphics and video editing skills: After Effects, Premiere Pro.
* Experience working with government entities, tourism boards, rights holders or sports federations in the region.
* Bilingual creative capability in English and Arabic.


**What Great Looks Like**
 Success in this role means producing creative that is confident, original and purposeful \- work that wins pitches, elevates client campaigns and makes the agency proud.
   

  

 You are the person who brings energy and clarity to a brief. You concept quickly, execute with precision, and know how to read a room when presenting. You understand the difference between a great idea and a great execution \- and you deliver both.
   

  

 You work well with strategy and account teams without needing to be spoon\-fed. You push back constructively when a brief is not right, and you take responsibility for quality at every stage of the process.
   

  

 You are as comfortable art directing an event identity system for a major sports property as you are turning around a social asset for a sponsor activation at pace. You understand sport, you understand the region, and you bring both to your work.
   

  

 Ready to lead. Built for sport and entertainment industry. Focused on quality, originality and delivery.
   

  

 This role is suited to a strong, confident Art Director who wants to be at the centre of one of the region's most exciting creative agency environments.
   

  

**Applications close on Friday, June 26, 2026\.**
**About Our Local Office**
 We were born out of the need for strategic and brutally effective creativity in the region. With every successful campaign, we have grown, and cherry\-picked the best professionals to work with us from all over the region and the world. In 2012, we opened our Abu Dhabi office and expanded our team with our Dubai office in 2016 and then our Riyadh office in 2023\. From these offices we manage a number of local and global brands across the Middle East and Europe. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is the creative philosophy of M\+C Saatchi. It defines the way we work and the work we produce. We believe: It’s easier to complicate than simplify. Simple ideas enter the brain quicker and stay there longer. Brutal Simplicity of Thought is therefore a painful necessity.
   

  

 ABOUT M\+C SAATCHI GROUP
   

  

 M\+C Saatchi Group is a creative federation of companies who navigate, create, and lead meaningful change for clients across five specialist divisions connected through people, culture, data, technology and creativity, M\+C Saatchi Group aims to unlock new value for clients and leave a positive impact on the world. M\+C Saatchi Group’s work is informed by two core principles \- Brutal Simplicity of Thought and Diversity of Thought. Together they guide how problems are solved and integrated specialist teams are built. Headquartered in London, M\+C Saatchi Group have circa 2,500 employees globally. Our global operations span 23 countries with major hubs in the UK, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 OUR AMBITION
   

  

 At M\+C Saatchi Group, our ambition is to create and curate Cultural Power for our clients. We do this by connecting specialist expertise, powered by creativity, data and technology, to help build famous brands and solve the most complex business and societal challenges.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through our global hub in Dubai, and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers 'Fly Better’.
   

  

 Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting\-edge information and technology team as an
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 .
   

  

 We are hiring a Delivery Manager with strong experience in Aviation Cargo or Logistics to lead large\-scale, AI\-driven in\-house development initiatives. The role also requires proven expertise in managing RFT processes, vendor selection, and end\-to\-end implementation of technology solutions. The ideal candidate will drive delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and innovation across complex, multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

 As the
 **Agile Delivery Manager \- SkyCargo** 
 , you will be responsible for planning, leading, organising, and motivating scrum teams either within a Release Train or outside to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high\-visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid (for Package Acquisition) methods in a fast\-paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, processes, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done, practicing servant leadership, and encourage discussion, decision making,g and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team\-level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensure each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace, adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g., ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work, leveraging cross\-functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput, and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both the product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance, and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements, etc., and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation/sizing exercise for both near\-term and future initiatives, and assist with preparing the total cost of ownership with the product team, maintain the actuals within the allocated budget, and ensure that forecasting for all the demands is accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* A Degree or Honours (12\+3\) or equivalent in Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
* 8\+ years of experience within Information Technology with proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programme.
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, PRINCE2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery, e.g., ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence, etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large\-scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core Scrum values of openness, honesty, and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Aviation Cargo or Logistics domain experience is preferred.


**Leadership Role:** 
 Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance, and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:**

 As a Data \& AI Project Manager, you will work within a team operating directly on a client project, reporting to a dedicated manager.

 • You own delivery of data, analytics, and AI engagements end\-to\-end — from discovery and scoping through design, build, UAT, and go\-live — under the supervision of your Project Director.

 • You manage project economics: budget tracking, margin, resource allocation, change requests, dependencies and risk mitigation.
 



 • You contribute to Apgar UAE’s growth by identifying expansion opportunities within your accounts and feeding insights back into our offerings and methodology

 • You participate in pre\-sales activities and responses to RFPs/tenders.
 



 • You contribute to implementation cost estimation and project planning.
 



 • You contribute to drafting commercial proposals.
 



  





**Your profile :** 




  





 • You hold a higher education degree (Bachelor’s/Master’s level) and have between 7 and 10 years of experience in a consulting firm or IT services company in the Data domain
 



 • You have strong interpersonal, commercial, and managerial skills, and are able to manage a project holistically from business, financial, and human perspectives.
 



 • It is mandatory to have experience in one of the following areas: MDM, Metadata, Data Integration, AI/ML and Data Preparation
 



  





  





**Why Join Apgar?** 




  





 • Be part of an international community of data experts
 



 • Work in a dynamic, fast\-growing, and innovative data environment
 



 • Benefit from a dedicated career coach and unlimited access to training platforms
 



 • Grow in a company that genuinely invests in people and expertise
 



  





**Perks \& Work Environment** 




  





 •Hybrid work model: 1–2 days remote per week \+ 2 weeks of remote work abroad
 



 •Benefits for major life events and year\-end celebrations
 



 •Competitive remuneration (fixed and variable packages)
 



 •Company\-supported training and career growth
 



 •Social and Family benefits (health insurance, annual visa, ticket)
 



 •Support for work\-life balance in a motivating and collegial workplace.
 



  





**Practical Information** 




  





 • Location: Dubai
 



 • Contract: Permanent / Full Time
 



 • Start date: As soon as possible
 



 • Compensation: Attractive package (fixed \+ variable), depending on profile

 • Initial CV screening conducted by a Recruitment Officer
 



 • Interview with the Recruitment Officer (20–45 minutes) to understand your motivations, assess alignment with our values, and review the key milestones of your professional background
 



 • Technical or functional interview, depending on the role, to assess your expertise including a business case (1 hour)

 As an ISO 27001 certified company, with strong security requirements for both our clients and ourselves, reference checks may be requested depending on the position and seniority level.

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.

 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.

 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.

 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.

 frameworks.

 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

The role also supports senior management in achieving operational and strategic objectives while ensuring effective coordination among clients, consultants, subcontractors, and internal teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Planning \& Control** 



* Develop, maintain, and monitor the project construction program in accordance with contract requirements.
* Prepare and maintain project procurement schedules to ensure timely delivery of materials and resources.
* Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to ensure completion within approved timelines.
* Ensure annual project delivery targets with a portfolio value of up to AED 50 million.



**Health, Safety \& Quality Management** 



* Develop and maintain project\-specific Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) plans in coordination with the HSE Manager and HSE Officers.
* Prepare method statements and risk assessments for project activities
 **.**
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, safety regulations, and contractual obligations.



**Procurement \& Material Management** 



* Coordinate and manage the procurement of all project\-specified finishing materials according to approved schedules.
* Monitor material submission schedules and ensure timely submission, approval, and procurement.
* Follow up on drawing submission schedules and ensure all required drawings are issued on time.



**Documentation \& Contract Administration** 



* Prepare, issue, and maintain records of Requests for Information, Non\-Conformance Reports, Inspection Requests, and related responses.
* Draft, review, and respond to formal project correspondence and contractual notices involving clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Maintain accurate project records and documentation throughout the project lifecycle
 **.**



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Chair meetings with clients, consultants, and subcontractors and maintain detailed meeting minutes.
* Maintain effective communication with clients, consultants, and subcontractors, ensuring prompt responses to all project\-related matters.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with all project stakeholders.



**Project Coordination \& Reporting** 



* Coordinate with site teams to identify and resolve project challenges and ensure smooth project execution.
* Ensure supervisory staff prepare and submit KPIs, daily work plans, and weekly work schedules while monitoring performance and progress.
* Issue weekly project progress reports, including site photographs, to clients.



**Project Completion \& Handover** 



* Ensure successful project closeout and obtain Taking Over Certificates from clients.
* Secure Final Completion Certificates upon completion of the Defects Liability Period.
* Ensure all contractual handover requirements are fulfilled and documented.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (preferred) or a related engineering discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant professional experience in engineering, construction, or project management environments.



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong problem\-solving skills with an innovative and practical approach.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
* Effective team player with strong collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management abilities.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet project deadlines



  





**Internal Relationships:** 
 MEP, Production, Technical, Purchase, Transport departments
 



**External Relationships:** 
 Sub\-Contractors, Contractors, Clients.

data.jd_text:
As a Technical Manager, you will be accountable for the Business Unit's P\&L and play a pivotal role in overseeing BIM implementation, multidisciplinary technical solution design, and project execution across various verticals. This role requires the ability to conceptualize and deliver complex, integrated solutions involving multiple technical disciplines, while also identifying and incorporating emerging technologies to enhance the Omnix solutions portfolio. Your leadership will ensure seamless coordination, operational excellence, and innovation across all projects.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



1. **Strategic \& Technical Oversight**


* Lead the design of complex technical solutions that integrate architecture, engineering, construction, and technology disciplines.
* Take full ownership of Business Unit P\&L, ensuring profitability, cost control, and value delivery.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies (e.g., digital twins, AI in design, generative modeling) to enhance service offerings and maintain a competitive edge.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align technical direction with business strategy and market demand.



**2\. BIM Implementation \& Optimization** 



* Ensure organization\-wide adherence to BIM standards, best practices, and project\-specific requirements.
* Oversee the coordination and integration of BIM models among multidisciplinary teams.
* Drive BIM automation, advanced data management practices, and interoperability across platforms.
* Mentor internal teams through knowledge\-sharing sessions, workshops, and on\-the\-job training to elevate BIM expertise.



**3\. Project Management \& Execution** 



* Manage planning, scheduling, and execution of BIM\-centric and multidisciplinary projects to ensure on\-time, within\-budget delivery.
* Lead stakeholder alignment meetings and ensure streamlined communication with clients, consultants, and vendors.
* Monitor project performance, track deliverables, and proactively identify and mitigate risks.
* Ensure project delivery complies with regulatory codes, technical standards, and client specifications.



**4\. Innovation \& Portfolio Enhancement** 



* Stay abreast of industry trends, digital construction technologies, and disruptive innovations.
* Recommend and implement new tools, methodologies, and services to enhance Omnix’s technical capabilities.
* Collaborate with leadership to expand the Omnix solution portfolio with innovative service lines.



**5\. Leadership \& Collaboration** 



* Act as a strategic bridge between design, engineering, and construction teams to maximize project success.
* Facilitate effective communication using BIM collaboration tools and digital platforms.
* Lead technical reviews, design validation workshops, and quality control initiatives.



  





**Qualification and Education Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* BIM certification (Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, or related tools) preferred.
* Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is a plus.



  





**Minimum Experience/Skills Required:** 



* 7–10 years of experience in BIM and integrated project delivery, including team or business unit leadership.
* Strong portfolio of designing and delivering complex multidisciplinary technical solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Dynamo, BIM 360, and related platforms.
* Familiarity with scheduling and planning tools such as Primavera P6 or MS Project.
* Proven experience in stakeholder management, technical team leadership, and budget accountability.
* Deep understanding of digital design practices, parametric modeling, and regulatory codes.

data.jd_text:
**About Arada**
 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the independent Cost Control Audit \& Governance function across pre\- and post\-contract stages for Arada’s portfolio. Operating as a mandatory control point, this role ensures absolute baseline integrity, strictly audits commercial recommendations prior to package awards, and enforces rigorous governance over the Forecast Final Cost (FFC) versus project budget, disciplined cost governance, and financial visibility for all projects. The role drives cost strategy, reporting integrity, and team capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Pre\-Award Independent Audit \& Gateway Control
* Mandatory Tender Sign\-Off: Review, audit, and provide formal feedback on all Pre\-Tender Estimates (PTE) and Tender Recommendation Reports before any package finalization.
* Independent Budget Verification: Act as an independent control point to cross\-verify procurement and commercial tender returns against the approved business case.
* Executive Gateway Reporting: Prepare and present concise "Gate Review" commercial analysis briefs to the Project Controls Director, CDO, and CEO, explicitly highlighting budget variances and risks prior to contract award.
* Design\-Stage Cost Checks: Monitor schematic and detailed design progressions to flag budget deviations early, forcing mandatory Value Engineering (VE) triggers if baselines are breached.
* Post\-Award Budget Governance \& FFC Control
* Budget vs. FFC Reconciliation: Own the monthly audit of Budget versus Forecast Final Cost (FFC) across all active assets. Identify and challenge hidden cost overruns or optimistic forecasting by project site teams.
* Contingency Drawdown Audit: Establish and enforce strict governance over project risks and contingencies. Validate that any drawdown request is backed by robust data and contractually justified.
* Trend Log \& Early Warning Governance: Implement and oversee an active Trend Log system to capture potential variations, design changes, and claims weeks before they manifest as formal commercial risks.
* Cost Monitoring, Reporting \& BI Automation
* Data Integrity Auditing: Validate and sign off on all monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and cost\-to\-complete metrics, ensuring they represent a single source of truth.
* Executive Dashboards: Drive the development of automated, live Power BI dashboards for the C\-suite, focusing strictly on Management by Exception by flagging projects tracking outside a 5% variance threshold.
* Proprietary Benchmarking: Oversee the construction and maintenance of a live internal cost\-per\-square\-foot benchmarking database using historical data from completed Arada phases.
* Team Leadership \& Interface
* Internal Audit Team Management: Manage and mentor Senior Cost Controllers and Analysts, instilling a culture of objective, data\-driven financial auditing.
* Cross\-Departmental Interface: Partner effectively with the established Pre\- and Post\-Contract Commercial, Procurement, and Project Management teams while maintaining strict departmental independence.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* MRICS certification is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* 12–15 years of experience in cost control, commercial management, or quantity surveying within top\-tier developers or international consultancies in the UAE.


**Technical Skills**
* Deep proficiency in enterprise cost management systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and reporting capabilities.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional analytical authority with the confidence and credibility to challenge commercial submissions and present objective risk data directly to executive leadership.

Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 Mace is delivering a large\-scale residential development in Dubai, forming part of the city’s continued urban growth. The programme involves the delivery of multiple assets across various construction stages, including units progressing into fit\-out.
   

  

 This is a fast\-paced, complex environment requiring strong coordination across design, construction, and commercial teams to ensure successful delivery.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Project Manager will report to the Senior Project Manager and be responsible for leading the delivery of multiple residential plots/assets throughout the construction lifecycle, including units progressing into fit\-out stages.
   

  

**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of residential assets, ensuring alignment with programme, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Manage contractors and consultants through the construction and fit\-out phases, ensuring works are progressing in line with approved plans.
* Support the Senior Project Manager in overseeing multiple project workstreams, maintaining clear reporting and governance.
* Drive programme performance, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies to maintain delivery milestones.
* Oversee the transition into and delivery of fit\-out works, ensuring quality standards and sequencing are effectively managed.
* Review contractor submissions, method statements, and progress reports, ensuring compliance with project requirements.
* Facilitate coordination between construction, design, commercial, and logistics teams to ensure integrated delivery.
* Monitor site progress, conduct regular inspections, and ensure adherence to health \& safety and quality standards.
* Support handover and closeout activities, ensuring a smooth transition to completion and client requirements are met.
* Contribute to value engineering and continuous improvement initiatives.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Degree qualified in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience as a Project Manager within a PMC/consultancy environment, delivering residential or mixed\-use developments.
* Strong experience in post\-contract delivery, including exposure to fit\-out stages of residential assets.
* Demonstrable experience managing contractors and multidisciplinary teams on site.
* Good understanding of construction sequencing, finishing stages, and handover processes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate within a structured programme environment.
* Commercial awareness with the ability to monitor progress against cost and programme.
* Experience working in the United Arab Emirates is essential for client approval.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** 
 We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long\-term relationships with our clients.
   

  

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

data.jd_text:
**Responsibilities:** 



* Provide inputs to the development of the overall division strategy and participate in developing the business unit strategy in line with the vision, mission, and business objectives of the company.
* Deliver the Facilities Management strategy while ensuring contractual commitments are successfully met.
* Manage the effective achievement of the business unit’s objectives through leading the Facilities and Operations team in the assigned project, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance.
* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.
* Lead and manage the Facilities Management function while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all the unit activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed unit objectives.
* Discuss “Side\-Specific\-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible.
* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.
* Monitor service delivery performance and lead the evaluation of suppliers’ performance to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service.
* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (projects, civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to audio visual equipment, BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.).
* Attend all coordination meetings with the tenants and contractors to discuss the progress of the fit out works and collect the required documentation, carry out an overall inspection after the completion of the fit out works, prepare the snag list to for the tenant, and follow up on all rectification works needed.
* Monitor the request for quotations and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays.
* Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted.
* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems).
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services the company provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation.
* Ensure the legionella reporting is timely sent to HSEEQ department.
* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department.
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented.
* Ensure availability of MS and RA



  





**Qualifications, Experiences, Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management in hospitality projects.

Can you lead commercial strategy for complex field developments — and maximize asset value?

 **plan, manage, and execute multi‑disciplinary well and field development projects** 
 through a single accountable team. Their mandate is to deliver predictable outcomes, optimize asset value, and reduce operational risk for operators.
   

  

**Fuel your passion**
 The
 **Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development** 
 is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
   

  

 This position requires strong E\&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end\-to\-end technical development plans into fit\-for\-purpose commercial structures.
   

  

**As an Integrated Commercial Director \- Field Development, you will be responsible for:**
* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client\-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end\-to\-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long\-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development\-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E\&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.


**To be successful in this role you will:**
* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10\+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E\&P business development function.
* Have 10\+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end\-to\-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, contractual risk, and profitability.

* Demonstrated ability to lead programs, projects, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation skills with experience managing complex customer discussions and commercial agreements.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Director \- Proposals

 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions


**Responsibilities**
* Expertise in electrical modelling and analysis software (ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, CDEGS, or similar)
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (Navisworks, AutoCAD, single\-line diagram tools)
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks and certifications (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) as they apply to data centres
* Experience with and understanding of the selection of electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities
* Familiarity with industry design standards and specifications (Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ISO standards for data centres)
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) certification preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency strategies, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewable energy integration in data centres
* Experience with utility (DEWA, TAQA, SEC) coordination, power infrastructure planning, and large load interconnection processes with regional utilities
* Knowledge of data centre monitoring and control systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS integration)
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project economics, risk management, and value engineering
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
