ESMT Berlin is a leading global business school with its campus in the heart of Berlin. Founded by 25 global companies, ESMT offers master, MBA, and PhD programs, as well as executive education on its campus in Berlin, in locations around the world, online, and in online blended format. We strongly believe in cross\-team collaboration to achieve our mission to develop entrepreneurial leaders who think globally and act responsibly.
 



  





 DEEP \- Institute for Deep Tech Innovation \- is ESMT’s innovation hub dedicated to amplifying our ecosystem’s ability to generate and scale science\-based businesses. We empower scientists to commercialize technologies, support deep tech startups to scale internationally and connect leading research organizations to connect with the startup and innovation ecosystem effectively.
 



  





 DEEP is running targeted and ambitious activities in the fields of Healthcare, Natural Capital, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence and Compute, currently expanding to Qatar
 



  





 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a
 



  





**Program Manager, DEEP Qatar** 




 (m/f/x, 40 hrs./week, starting in August\-September 2026, on\-site in Doha)
 



  





 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.
 



  





**How you'll make a difference** 




 The Program Manager is central to executing DEEP Qatar's local initiatives and supporting the delivery of the three flagship programs: DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. They make sure every cohort week, venture session, and mentor gathering runs flawlessly on the ground in Doha, and help establish DEEP Qatar's brand presence locally through digital channels and a physical presence at ecosystem events.
 



 They work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin to maintain consistency with global CDL standards, and with the Doha\-based Venture Managers on local delivery and venture intake. In year one, this is a build\-as\-you\-go role, requiring the entrepreneurialism to figure things out in a new market without a local playbook.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Program delivery** 




 Own end\-to\-end local build and delivery for cohort sessions across DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha. Manage scheduling, logistics, venues, catering, and travel for participants, mentors, and faculty. Manage faculty, speakers, and practitioners across the programs, including onboarding, attendance, briefings, and on\-site coordination. Serve as the first point of contact for participants during cohort weeks. Ensure programs run to CDL global standards while adapting to the local context. Own project\-level budget management across programs, tracking spend and reporting into the overall Qatar program budget managed by the Operations Lead. Manage inbound inquiries.
 



**Berlin coordination** 




 Work closely with the Program Operations team in Berlin (led by the Head of Operations) and the Berlin\-based Program Managers to ensure alignment across the DEEP network. Provide local execution support for Berlin\-led activities that involve Qatar and draw on Berlin's support for Qatar\-led cohorts, particularly during the first year of the programs.
 



**Venture Manager support** 




 Provide local logistical support to Venture Managers across the program verticals, including coordinating venture visits, founder sessions, and ecosystem touchpoints in Qatar. Support Venture Managers with the application process and onboarding of candidates and ventures into the programs.
 



**Ecosystem days and gatherings**

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will assist QNB Capital’s team with translation requests under the supervision of QNB Capital’s Managing Director. The incumbent will draft, translate, review or proofread the translation of a range of materials, including official correspondence, letters, presentations, speeches, emails, and financial/legal documents, among others. The incumbent will ensure that all translated documents are formatted and presented appropriately in standard business formats using Microsoft Word and Microsoft PowerPoint. The incumbent will assist the QNB Capital team with various tasks that require Arabic language skills.

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Translator
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimize cost, avoid waste, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Deliver translations in line with the requirements of QNB Capital senior management
* Assist and undertake the translation (Arabic into English and vice versa) of various materials
* Assist the verification and proof\-reading of all translations provided from external sources
* Work closely with QNB Capital’s team to finalize any deliverables that are required to be submitted to clients, regulators or any other external parties in Arabic.
* Work closely with the QNB Capital team in preparing the translation of documents related to regulatory submissions
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group's objectives.
* Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Learning \& Knowledge:

* Identify related areas for self\-professional development and act to enhance self\-professional development.
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.

* Place the integrity of the investment profession and the interests of clients above their own personal interests.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Familiarity with Finance, Banking, Economics and Legal concepts and terms is preferred.

HBKU is a homegrown research\-intensive University offering undergraduate and graduate degrees that acts as a catalyst for positive transformation in Qatar and the region while having a global impact.
   

  

 Doha is the home of Education City (https://www.qf.org.qa/education/higher\-education), a dedicated campus devoted to research and education. In addition to HBKU, Education City hosts other academic institutions, including Weill Cornell Medicine\-Qatar, Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar, VCUarts Qatar, Northwestern University in Qatar, and Georgetown University in Qatar. Education City has significantly contributed to the development of post\-secondary education and cultural growth in Qatar.
   

  

**About Entity**
 Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) established the College of Public Policy in 2019\. The College has three degrees (Master of Public Policy, Master of Social Policy and Program Evaluation, Master of Global Health Policy) and Executive Programs (in collaboration with Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies in Geneva). The College works to empower the next generation of ethically grounded public leaders in Qatar and beyond. Students are given an inclusive and diverse learning environment that promotes a culture of excellence, integrity, respect, and fairness.  he Master of Global Health Policy (MGHP) program prepares graduates to address complex health challenges through policy analysis, interdisciplinary evidence, stakeholder engagement, ethical leadership, and public\-service\-oriented decision\-making.  Full Professor
   

  

 To conduct teaching, research and service to contribute to HBKU becoming a world\-class research university and collaborate with faculty members and students to create a vibrant university community that will positively impact and contribute to the development of Qatar and the region by advancing knowledge in their field and developing human capacity through their teaching

 Join our DEEP Qatar team on\-site as a

 and help shape the future by bringing your expertise and passion to ESMT.

 The Operations Lead is responsible for the operational backbone of DEEP Qatar. They keep the Qatar site running, manage operational tracking of the program budget, and provide operational support across the three flagship programs (DEEP Academy, DEEP Pioneers, and CDL Doha).

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi\-channel chatbots, and a production\-grade multi\-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. You will lead a focused team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers, turning operational SOPs into autonomous, reliable workflows that serve drivers in real time across Qatar.
   

  

 In this role you will set the technical direction, establish engineering standards, and own delivery end\-to\-end — from architecture decisions and code reviews to observability and cost governance. You will work directly with the R\&D Director and Product to shape what gets built next, then lead your team to ship it with excellence.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
 Team Leadership \& Delivery:
   

  

* 
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a cross\-functional team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers — driving technical quality, delivery velocity, and engineering culture.
+ Own sprint planning, technical scope definition, and delivery commitments for the conversational AI and driver automation domain.
+ Conduct design reviews, define coding standards, and maintain engineering quality across IVR, chatbot, and agentic system codebases.
+ Act as the primary technical interface between Engineering, Product, and Operations for all driver\-facing automation initiatives.
+ Partner with the R\&D Director to shape the team's technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI capabilities, and surface the next high\-leverage bets.


**IVR \& Voice Automation**
* 
+ Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice\-to\-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation\-to\-human ratios.


**Conversational AI \& Chatbots**
* 
+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi\-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real\-time chat channels.
+ Own the four\-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.


 Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver\-facing apps via secure, event\-driven patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI \& SOP Automation**
* 
+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs\-as\-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine\-readable policies executed by the multi\-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.


**AWS Infrastructure \& MLOps**
* 
+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.

+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open\-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.

**Experience**
* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end\-to\-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching\-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production\-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.

* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.

* IVR architecture: call flow design, intent/slot management, DTMF handling, escalationto\-human routing, and SLA monitoring.
* Experience with STT/TTS pipelines or voice bot platforms is a strong plus.


**AWS Services (Core)**

* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.

* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Grocery Operations


 Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick\-commerce partners.
   

  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out\-of\-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.
* Improve picking, packing, and handover processes with partners.
* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold\-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark\-store or quick\-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.
* Laundry Operations


 Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end\-to\-end laundry order flow.
   

  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high\-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.
* Ticketing Operations


 Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
   

  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event\-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.


**Additional Verticals And Business Areas**
 Based on Snoonu’s business model, the Vertical Operations Director may also oversee or support the following areas:
   

  

* Retail Operations


 For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
   

  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category\-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations


 Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
   

  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations


 Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
   

  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* Vertical Strategy and Operating Model ( Define the operating model for each vertical; Set operational priorities, KPIs, and service standards; Translate Snoonu’s business goals into clear execution plans).
* Operational Performance ( Own the day\-to\-day performance of each vertical; Monitor key metrics; Identify operational bottlenecks and solve them with clear owners; Ensure every vertical has weekly performance reviews and action plans).
* Customer Experience ( Ensure every vertical delivers a customer experience aligned with Snoonu’s standards; Work closely with Customer Experience and Customer Support to understand complaints and root causes; Reduce repeated failures that create customer dissatisfaction; Ensure service recovery rules are clear for each vertical; Protect the customer first, then fix the root cause internally) .
* Partner and Merchant Operational Excellence ( Set clear operational requirements for merchants and partners; Hold partners accountable for repeated failures; Work with commercial and account management teams to improve partner performance; Ensure partners understand Snoonu’s standards for preparation, availability, packaging, handover, and customer experience; Recommend corrective actions for underperforming partners).
* Cross\-Functional Leadership ( This role must connect all departments to ensure that vertical issues are solved end\-to\-end).
* SOPs, SLAs, and Governance ( Create and maintain SOPs for each vertical; Define clear SLAs for merchants, operations, logistics, and support teams; Build escalation processes for critical issues; Ensure every team knows who owns each type of problem; Standardize processes across verticals to reduce confusion and improve execution) .
* Data, Reporting, and Business Reviews ( Build dashboards for each vertical; Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance; Identify trends, risks, and repeated failures; Present clear business reviews to leadership; Convert data into action plans, not just reports).
* Profitability and Unit Economics ( Work with finance and commercial teams to improve vertical profitability; Monitor cost\-to\-serve across each vertical; Identify operational inefficiencies that affect margins; Improve delivery batching, fulfillment efficiency, partner terms, and refund leakage; Ensure growth does not come at the cost of poor economics).

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support

data.jd_text:
**Title:** 
 Construction Manager
 **–** 
 Airside (Runway/Taxiway/Apron/Road Works)
 



**Location :** 
 Kinshasa, DRC
 



**Reporting to :** 
 Airport Project Director
 



**Contract Type :** 
 Expatriate Assignment
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Construction Manager will lead the delivery of a large\-scale airport infrastructure project in Kinshasa, ensuring safe, timely, and cost\-effective execution in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The role oversees all on\-site construction activities, including planning, drawings interpretation, method statements, and management of plant, equipment, and site resources.
 



  





 Responsible for airside works such as runways, taxiways, aprons, drainage, roads, utilities, and AGL interfaces, the role requires strong hands\-on leadership in a high\-risk operational environment with strict access control and interface coordination.
 



  





 The position demands robust technical expertise and disciplined execution within operational airside constraints, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures, FOD prevention, work permits, and handback requirements, while maintaining full accountability for site execution, quantities, and resources.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Execution** 




  




* Lead and coordinate day\-to\-day construction activities across assigned workstreams.
* Support technical and feasibility studies, including site investigations and risk assessments.
* Translate engineering designs into executable construction plans.
* Monitor project timelines and ensure adherence to approved schedules.
* Plan and manage airside phasing and work windows, including shift/night works where required, ensuring safe demarcation, temporary arrangements, and handback readiness.
* Coordinate airside execution interfaces (earthworks/pavements/drainage/duct banks/AGL interfaces) to avoid rework and to maintain a clear critical path for airside readiness.
* Ensure survey control, setting\-out and level/line control are established and maintained for airside geometry compliance (grades, levels, transitions) and that as\-built data is captured progressively.
* Review and interpret approved drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, and related technical documents, and ensure construction works are executed in accordance with the latest approved information.
* Review, comment on, and ensure implementation of method statements, inspection and test plans, work packs, permits, and short\-term execution plans before works commence.
* Plan and control site resource deployment, including labour, plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, access arrangements, and lifting requirements for each work front.
* Coordinate with Technical, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Commercial, and Project Controls to ensure construction activities are properly supported and sequenced, while maintaining Construction accountability for execution decisions and site inputs.



  





**Procurement \& Contract Management** 




  




* Contribute to the preparation of technical specifications and scope of work.
* Support tendering processes, including contractor selection and bid evaluations.



  





**Construction Quantities, Plant \& Resource Accountability** 




  




* Remain accountable and responsible for defining, reviewing, and formally signing off the plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site execution resources required for the works.
* Review and verify material quantities, equipment requests, and site resource plans before submission to Procurement or other support functions.
* Monitor plant utilisation, availability, maintenance status, suitability, and replacement needs, and take corrective action where shortfalls may affect safety, quality, cost, or programme.
* Review and sign off measured quantities, quantity take\-offs, measurement sheets, and supporting site records before issue for progress measurement, valuation support, reporting, or third\-party use.



  





**Site Supervision \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Supervise construction works to ensure compliance with design specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements.
* Identify and resolve design, technical, and execution issues in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections and enforce quality control procedures.
* Ensure airside pavement works (subgrade, capping, subbase/base, asphalt/concrete as applicable) comply with approved ITPs, testing frequencies, and acceptance criteria; drive timely corrective actions for non\-conformities.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and testing laboratories to ensure traceable test results, approvals, and release of work fronts prior to subsequent layers/activities.
* Coordinate AGL civil readiness (duct banks, pits, chambers, cable routes, bases) and support commissioning readiness activities by ensuring construction completion and close\-out of punch items affecting AGL installation/testing.
* Carry out constructability, interface, and field\-readiness reviews to confirm that works can be executed safely, efficiently, and in line with approved drawings and site conditions.
* Verify installed quantities, field measurements, and supporting site records before these are issued for progress measurement, valuation support, or reporting.
* Review subcontractor and supplier execution documentation, including shop drawings, method statements, lifting plans, temporary works submissions, and ITPs, and ensure comments are closed out before implementation.



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 




  




* Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
* Enforce compliance with local regulations and international construction standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all contractors and site personnel. Implement airside\-specific safety controls including airside driving rules, access/escort protocols, exclusion zones, communications/briefings, and stringent FOD prevention, ensuring that all personnel and subcontractors comply with airside operational safety requirements.
* Ensure work areas are secured with compliant barricading/marking and that temporary conditions do not create hazards to aircraft operations.
* Ensure daily FOD walks/controls and strict housekeeping standards are implemented and recorded.
* Ensure that method statements, permits to work, lifting plans, and task\-specific risk assessments are reviewed and implemented before execution.



  





**Risk \& Issue Management** 




  




* Identify potential project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Proactively resolve construction challenges to avoid delays or cost overruns.
* Provide early warning on discrepancies in drawings, quantities, site conditions, plant or equipment performance, and subcontractor capability that may affect delivery.
* Provide early warning on airside operational constraints, access restrictions, interface clashes, and handback risks that may affect safety, programme, or readiness milestones; propose mitigation and recovery actions.



  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




  




* Perform any other related duties as assigned by management in support of project delivery. This includes formal construction review and sign\-off on relevant site execution matters where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of
 **7–10 years of experience** 
 in construction management, preferably in large\-scale infrastructure or airport projects.
* Proven experience managing contractors and complex construction sites.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airside works (runway/taxiway/apron/roads earthworks and pavements and/or airfield civil works) with strong understanding of airside execution constraints.
* Experience working in operational airfield environments or under strict access and permit\-to\-work controls is a strong advantage.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with ICAO airfield requirements (geometry, safety areas, markings/signage/AGL interfaces) and airside compliance constraints is a strong advantage.
* Experience working in Africa, preferably in challenging or emerging markets.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, method statements, inspection and test plans, and related technical documentation.
* Practical experience in quantity verification, progress measurement, field productivity monitoring, and review/sign\-off of site execution records.
* Strong understanding of plant, equipment, machinery, temporary works, materials planning, and construction resource control.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Strong leadership and site management skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety
* Fluent in English is mandatory; professional working proficiency in French is strongly preferred.
* Strong technical ability in reading drawings, verifying quantities, reviewing method statements, and assessing construction resource requirements.
* Clear ownership mindset for plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site productivity.
* Strong discipline in permit\-to\-work compliance, shift handback readiness, and interface coordination in constrained operational environments.
* High standards of field leadership, subcontractor control, and delivery predictability under fast\-paced conditions.



  





**Work Environment** 




  




* Site\-based role in Kinshasa with regular presence on construction sites
* May require extended working hours depending on project needs
* Exposure to a dynamic, fast\-paced infrastructure development environment

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 A landmark, large\-scale mixed\-use destination development is underway in Qatar — one of the most ambitious leisure, retail, and real estate projects in the region. Spanning entertainment, hospitality, retail, and residential components across a significant land area in the greater Doha area, this project represents a generational investment in Qatar's tourism and economic diversification ambitions.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The project is at a pivotal stage of development, and we are seeking an exceptional Contracts \& Commercial Director to lead the full commercial and contracts function from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Contracts \& Commercial Director will be the most senior commercial authority on the project. This is a leadership role with strategic accountability for all contracts, procurement, cost management, and commercial governance across the entire development programme — spanning design, construction, fit\-out, retail leasing infrastructure, and operational commissioning phases. The successful candidate will build and lead a high\-performing commercial team, establish robust contract frameworks, protect the project's financial interests, and ensure that all commercial decisions are aligned with the project's master development strategy.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* **Contracts Management**
* Own end\-to\-end contract strategy, administration, and execution across all project workstreams including civil works, MEP, fit\-out, retail, leisure, and hospitality packages
* Lead the preparation, negotiation, and award of all major contracts (FIDIC, NEC, bespoke forms), ensuring appropriate risk allocation and commercial protection
* Manage the full claims lifecycle — anticipation, assessment, negotiation, and resolution — minimising exposure and disputes
* Establish and maintain a contract register, variation management system, and claims log with full governance and audit trail
* Interface with legal counsel on contractual disputes, arbitration, and enforcement matters
* 
* **Commercial Management**
* Develop and implement the project's overarching commercial strategy in alignment with the CEO and development board
* Own the project cost plan, budget, and cost\-to\-complete reporting, providing accurate and timely commercial reporting to senior leadership and ownership
* Lead value engineering initiatives without compromising design intent or operational quality
* Drive procurement strategy — packaging, market engagement, tendering, evaluation, and award — for all consultants, contractors, and specialist vendors
* Establish commercial governance frameworks including delegation of authority, approval workflows, and commercial risk registers
* Oversee the benchmarking of contract prices against market rates and comparable regional projects
* 
* **Retail \& Real Estate Commercial**
* Provide commercial oversight on retail leasing structures, anchor tenant agreements, and fit\-out contribution frameworks
* Advise on commercial terms for real estate sales, land disposal, and development management agreements
* Support the delivery of F\&B, hospitality, and entertainment operator agreements from a contracts and commercial perspective
* 
* **Leadership \& Team Building**
* Recruit, build, and mentor a multi\-disciplinary commercial team (quantity surveyors, contracts managers, commercial analysts)
* Foster a high\-performance, ethical, and collaborative commercial culture across the project
* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team
* Represent the project in dealings with government entities, master developers, and regulatory bodies where commercial matters arise



  





  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Essential
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in contracts and commercial management, with at least 5 years at Director level
* Proven experience on large\-scale retail, real estate, or mixed\-use destination development projects (total contract value ≥ QAR 500M)
* Deep expertise in FIDIC (Red, Yellow, Silver Books) and/or NEC contract suites
* Demonstrated track record in claims management, dispute avoidance, and commercial dispute resolution
* Experience building and leading commercial teams in a project delivery environment
* Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline
* 
* Highly Desirable
* MRICS / FRICS qualification or equivalent professional accreditation
* Prior experience on landmark GCC destination, leisure, or entertainment projects (e.g. Lusail City, Place Vendôme Qatar, Diriyah Gate, NEOM, Yas Island, Expo City)
* Familiarity with Qatari regulatory, procurement, and legal framework
* Experience with retail leasing commercial structures and entertainment/hospitality operator agreements
* Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not mandatory)
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:

**Job Summary:**

* Support continuous enhancement of corporate performance management frameworks, in alignment of global best practices and standards.
* Deliver successful monitoring of MCQ’s performance governance frameworks and models as aligned with MCQ Strategy.
* Monitor and report on the organization’s portfolio of programs and projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and performance targets.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reports to track and visualize Key Performance Indicators at both project and corporate levels.
* Perform analysis and insights of performance data to identify gaps, opportunities, risks, and identify escalation points (if any).

**Reporting**

 This role oversees network operations, infrastructure modernization, automation
data.jd_text:
The Head of Network Infrastructure Operations is responsible for defining and executing the organization's network infrastructure strategy while ensuring operational excellence across all network services.
 



  





 This role oversees network operations, infrastructure modernization, automation initiatives, security compliance, vendor management, and the delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure network environments aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Operational Excellence \& NOC Management** 




  




* Lead and oversee the 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) to ensure proactive monitoring and rapid incident response.
* Establish, measure, and continuously improve network Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage engineering teams operating in high\-pressure, mission\-critical environments with strict uptime requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and event organizers to translate operational requirements into technical network solutions.
* Lead the response to major incidents and ensure detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action plans are completed.



  





**Strategic Infrastructure Roadmap** 




  




* Develop and execute the long\-term network infrastructure strategy.
* Design and implement scalable enterprise network architectures across LAN, WAN, Data Center, and Cloud environments.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies such as SD\-WAN, WiFi 6E, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Lead infrastructure transformation initiatives, including the retirement of legacy platforms and migration to modern network technologies.



  





**Network Automation \& Innovation** 




  




* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational activities and improve efficiency.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated change management processes for network operations.
* Standardize infrastructure deployment and configuration management using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Python.
* Promote innovation and continuous improvement across network engineering and operations teams.



  





**Risk Management \& Security Compliance** 




  




* Partner with Information Security teams to implement Zero Trust networking principles and enterprise firewall policies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001 and SOC 2\.
* Develop and maintain disaster recovery (DR) strategies and business continuity plans.
* Conduct regular testing and validation of recovery procedures and operational resilience capabilities.



  





**Financial \& Vendor Management** 




  




* Own and manage annual network infrastructure CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
* Lead negotiations with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), hardware vendors, and managed service providers.
* Manage vendor performance and conduct regular business reviews with strategic technology partners.
* Ensure investments deliver measurable business value and operational efficiency.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 12–15 years of experience in Network Engineering, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale, multi\-vendor enterprise network environments including Cisco, Arista, HPE, and related technologies.
* Deep expertise in global backbone and enterprise networking technologies, including BGP, MPLS, SD\-WAN, and VXLAN.
* Strong experience with hybrid cloud connectivity solutions, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS Direct Connect, and Azure ExpressRoute.
* Proven hands\-on experience with data center networking technologies, including Cisco ACI, Cisco Nexus Switching, Cisco UCS, and VMware NSX.



  





**Competencies** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert\-level knowledge of centralized network controllers and software\-defined fabrics such as Cisco ACI, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Deep expertise in enterprise and service provider routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EVPN.
* Strong understanding of encapsulation and transport technologies such as VXLAN and MPLS.
* Proven ability to design and manage virtual overlays, logical network segmentation, and micro\-segmentation security policies.
* Strong knowledge of network automation and orchestration using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and related technologies.
* Advanced expertise in Layer 4–Layer 7 technologies including load balancing, traffic engineering, and Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB).
* Expertise in integrating firewalls, IDS/IPS solutions, and Zero Trust security frameworks within enterprise network architectures.
* Advanced knowledge of deep packet inspection, flow telemetry, network observability, and proactive performance monitoring.
* Ability to optimize latency, throughput, availability, and overall network performance.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




  




* Valid CCIE Certification (Mandatory).
* CCNP
* ITIL Foundation
* PMP
* Azure Certified Advanced Networking

We are conducting a confidential search for a highly accomplished Chief Investment Officer (CIO) to lead the investment strategy, portfolio management, and product development activities of a growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing a diversified multi\-asset investment portfolio while driving the development and structuring of innovative investment products to support business growth and client objectives.
 



  





 This is a senior leadership role requiring strong investment expertise, commercial acumen, and a proven track record across multiple asset classes and investment vehicles.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Investment Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the organization's investment strategy across multiple asset classes, including public equities, fixed income, private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and alternative investments.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction decisions.
* Monitor portfolio performance, risk exposures, market trends, and economic developments.
* Present investment recommendations and portfolio updates to executive management, investment committees, and boards.
* Ensure investment activities align with regulatory requirements, governance frameworks, and risk appetite.



  





 Product Structuring \& Development
 


* Lead the design, structuring, launch, and ongoing management of investment products and investment vehicles.
* Develop innovative solutions tailored to institutional, family office, and high\-net\-worth investor requirements.
* Collaborate with legal, compliance, operations, finance, and distribution teams to bring products to market.
* Evaluate and establish appropriate fund structures, mandates, and investment frameworks.
* Support fundraising initiatives through product positioning and investor engagement.



  





 Investment Origination \& Execution
 


* Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across asset classes and geographies.
* Lead due diligence processes and investment recommendations.
* Oversee external managers, advisors, and strategic investment partners.
* Drive portfolio optimization and capital deployment decisions.



  





 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing investment team.
* Foster a strong investment culture focused on performance, discipline, and innovation.
* Maintain relationships with investors, regulators, financial institutions, and industry stakeholders.
* Act as a key spokesperson on investment matters internally and externally.



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree (MBA, MSc Finance, Economics, or equivalent) preferred.
* CFA, CAIA, FRM, or other relevant professional qualifications highly desirable.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive investment management experience.
* Proven experience managing diversified multi\-asset portfolios.
* Strong experience in investment product structuring, fund formation, and product development.

The Art Director leads the creative and visual direction of our company's brands and initiatives, ensuring all visual output aligns with brand strategy, audience expectations, and business objectives.

The role also provides leadership and direction to the design team while collaborating closely with Brand Managers, Content, Digital, PR, and external creative partners.

* Creative quality assurance and design standards
* Design team leadership and development
* Evolution of brand guidelines and visual systems

**1\. Creative Strategy** 



* Define and continuously evolve the visual language of our company and its portfolio brands
* Develop creative concepts and visual frameworks that support brand positioning and marketing objectives
* Translate strategic briefs into compelling creative directions, narratives, and design systems
* Lead the development of campaign concepts, key visuals, and integrated creative platforms
* Identify opportunities to elevate brand perception through innovative and culturally relevant creative approaches



**2\. Brand Governance \& Design Excellence** 



* Act as the guardian of brand identity, ensuring consistency across all channels and touchpoints
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, visual standards, and creative toolkits
* Establish creative review processes and quality control measures across the department

* Ensure typography, imagery, color systems, layouts, and graphic assets are applied consistently

**3\. Campaign Creative Development.** 



* Lead creative development across seasonal campaigns, launches, partnerships, activations, and major events

* Partner with Brand Managers to translate marketing objectives into impactful creative solutions
* Ensure campaign creative is adapted effectively across digital, print, social, environmental, and experiential channels
* Collaborate with Digital and Content teams to create engaging audience\-facing assets



**4\. Art Direction \& Content Production** 



* Lead the visual direction of photography, videography, and content production projects
* Develop shot lists, styling directions, references, and creative treatments – when needed
* Provide on\-site creative leadership during shoots and productions – when needed
* Guide image selection, post\-production, retouching, editing, and final asset delivery



**5\. Creative Leadership \& Operations** 



* Provide clear creative direction, conduct regular design reviews, and ensure consistent application of brand standards across all projects

**6\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Partner closely with Brand Managers, Communications, Digital Marketing, and Content teams to ensure integrated execution

* Contribute to the creative direction of new brand launches, partnerships, and commercial ventures
* Act as a trusted creative advisor across the business



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Art Direction, or a related field
* 8 to 10 years of experience in creative design, branding, or visual communications
* Minimum 3 years of experience in an Art Director or senior creative leadership role
* Strong portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, creative leadership, and execution across multiple channels
* Experience managing designers and leading creative teams
* Experience within hospitality, retail, cultural, luxury, lifestyle, or destination brands is strongly preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and relevant creative tools
* Experience directing photography and video productions



  





 Key Attributes
 


* Exceptional visual storytelling and conceptual thinking skills
* Strong creative leadership and decision\-making capabilities
* Ability to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to creative excellence
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills
* Collaborative and solutions\-oriented mindset
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities
* Passion for culture, design, hospitality, and audience engagement

data.jd_text:
We are a Qatar\-based diversified investment holding group operating across five core business verticals: Infrastructure \& Contracting Ventures, Property Development, Hospitality \& Healthcare, Financial Services, and a Services Group encompassing Manpower, Facilities Management, and Catering. With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, Algeria, Egypt, and Venezuela — the Group manages a complex, multi\-currency portfolio of businesses and investments requiring sophisticated treasury leadership.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head of Treasury will be responsible for leading the Group’s capital structure, liquidity, funding strategy, and financial risk management framework. This is a critical executive role acting as the primary interface with international banking partners, credit institutions, and institutional stakeholders, ensuring robust financial governance, funding efficiency, and strategic capital allocation across the Group.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Debt \& Capital Structure** 



* Lead debt restructuring, refinancing, and capital optimization initiatives
* Develop and execute group\-wide funding and leverage strategies
* Manage corporate borrowing facilities and covenant compliance
* Present treasury strategy to CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee



**Syndicated Loans \& Banking** 



* Structure and negotiate syndicated and bilateral credit facilities with international banks
* Manage global banking relationships and lender communications
* Oversee loan documentation and legal coordination



**Liquidity \& Cash Management** 



* Oversee global liquidity, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization
* Implement cash pooling and intercompany funding structures
* Ensure adequate liquidity buffers across all entities



**Risk Management** 



* Design FX, interest rate, and commodity hedging strategies
* Manage derivatives, ISDA agreements, and hedge accounting compliance (IFRS 9\)



**Governance \& Strategy** 



* Develop treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks
* Deliver treasury reporting to Board and external stakeholders
* Support M\&A, capital raising, and strategic finance initiatives
* Lead and develop the treasury team



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Essential** 



* 18\+ years of treasury experience, including 8\+ years in senior leadership roles
* Proven experience in debt restructuring and syndicated financing
* Strong expertise in liquidity management, FX risk, and capital markets
* Experience within large corporates, conglomerates, or investment holding groups
* Strong understanding of financial instruments and credit documentation (LMA preferred)
* Professional qualification (ACT, CFA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent)



**Desirable** 



* SAP TRM or treasury management systems experience
* Exposure to GCC, MENA, Africa, or frontier markets
* Experience with capital controls or complex jurisdictions
* ESG financing (green bonds / sustainability\-linked loans)
* High\-yield or leveraged finance exposure



**Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Presence
* Negotiation Strength
* Risk Awareness
* People Leadership
* Strong Governance Mindset

Across every step — from integration to delivery — our people act with passion, ownership, and determination to ensure life\-saving medicines become available to patients who need them, worldwide.
   

  

**Broad Overview:**
 The Commercial Director for MENA leads the commercial performance and launch execution of newly registered MA products across the Gulf and Levant. The role provides senior commercial leadership across the region, overseeing a team of KAMs and ensuring strong execution through both distributors and field teams. With close cross\-functional collaboration with Marketing, Medical (MSLs), RA, QA, and Supply Chain, the position ensures compliant, high\-quality execution and reinforces SERB’s presence across key hospital and tender\-driven markets.
   

  

 The role will be home based (location Riyadh) and the incumbent will be required to travel approx. 60% of their time across the GCC.
   

  

**As the Commercial Director, MENA your responsibilities will include:**
* Define and execute the commercial strategy for GCC and Levant aligned with MEA strategic priorities and global brand objectives.
* Own the regional revenue delivery, sales performance, and profitability for all newly registered MA products.
* Lead the annual Business Plan (BP) development, target setting, and rolling forecast processes for the region.

* Minimum 10 years of pharmaceutical commercial experience across KSA and GCC.
* At least 3–5 years in a senior sales management role leading KAMs and distributors.
* Proven track record in launching newly registered MA products and growing hospital/tender\-driven portfolios.
* Strong experience in forecasting, tender processes, and business planning.
