* Strong communication and presentation skills, with executive\-level influence.
* High level of integrity and compliance mindset, ensuring strict adherence to internal and external regulations.
* Agility, resilience, and strong problem\-solving skills in fast\-changing market environments.
* Fluency in English; Arabic is a strong asset.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of driving impactful projects that enhance our global energy solutions. This role targets experienced project managers with a background in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or mechatronics, who are adept at navigating complex challenges and leading diverse teams. Your work will directly contribute to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions, fostering innovation, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. Expect a collaborative team culture that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement, where your leadership will inspire and empower others to achieve shared goals.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead cross\-functional teams across various locations, ensuring effective collaboration and accountability for project outcomes.
* Develop and implement structured communication plans to maintain transparency with stakeholders and facilitate milestone tracking.
* Manage the full project lifecycle, from scope definition to closure, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Utilize Siemens Energy tools and digital platforms for data\-driven decision\-making, process optimization, and comprehensive reporting.
* Drive change through coaching and mentoring, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks using procurement plans and responsibility matrices, ensuring project health and compliance.


**What You Bring**
* A Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field, with specialization or certification in project management (IPMA\-C or PMP is a plus).
* 5 to 10 years of experience in project management or team leadership, with a proven track record of managing complex projects in a multinational and multicultural environment.
* Strong documentation skills for project reporting, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication, with familiarity in audit processes and quality gates (QMiP, FAC, etc.).
* Proficiency in project lifecycle management, budgeting, risk analysis, and contract handling using Siemens Energy standards and tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills for managing relationships, resolving conflicts, and communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Initiative, adaptability, and ownership in achieving project outcomes under dynamic conditions, with a focus on innovation and analytical thinking.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

data.jd_text:
The Project Manager's role is essential in ensuring the successful delivery of projects. The role holder will lead the implementation of small to large projects and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and a range of internal and external stakeholders. This role will deploy the full range of the department's tools and processes to ensure the successful design and deployment and delivery of all assigned projects throughout their full lifecycles with a strong focus on achieving the intended benefits and operational performance goals.
 


**General Responsibilities**
* Manage and execute projects under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager and the Project Delivery Lead Management to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with predefined and agreed objectives and quality standards.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, and budgets. Continuously monitor project progress, identifying and addressing issues, risks and changes as they arise.
* Work with the Director Project Delivery Lead Management to define project milestones/objectives and deliverables for projects and establish a framework for monitoring and reporting project performance.
* Collaborate with project team members to identify and implement improvement strategies that enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness and mitigate issues and risks.
* Work closely with various departments within the Centre of Excellence (COE) to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of project activities with overall business objectives.
* Foster effective communication and collaboration among project team members and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned with project goals, objectives and the status of all assigned projects.
* Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure that projects meet or exceed quality standards and customer expectations.
* Conduct regular project audits to verify adherence to established quality guidelines and identify areas for improvement.
* Identify potential project issues, risks, changes and collaborate within the Project Delivery Teams to develop contingency and mitigation plans to proactively address challenges that may impact project delivery.
* Allocate and manage project resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to optimize project delivery and ensure the efficient utilization of resources.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, all project logs and documentation of lessons learned, in line with organizational standards.
* Provide regular updates and reports on project status to the Director Project Delivery Lead Management, Chief Operational Excellence Officer, and relevant stakeholders.
* Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency.
* Implement all relevant Department's policies, processes, procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies, and standards.


**Requirements**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required.
* Master's degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred.
* PMP or Prince2 certification is required.
* Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written business English.
* **7\+ years of experience in project management or a related field preferably into Supplychain industries, including planning, execution, delivery, and reporting.**
* Proven experience in project management, including planning, execution, delivery, reporting and effective communication.
* Experience working with leadership and senior stakeholders and coordinating across internal cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with any one of PMP\-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, or structured reporting and governance.
* Broader experience across PMP\-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, and structured reporting and governance is preferred.
* Experience in logistics and supply chain projects is preferred.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a frozen food manufacturer in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Operations Director (Head of Factory).
   

  

****Role Purpose****
 The Operations Director holds full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the plant's operational strategy, building a high\-performing organization, and delivering against ambitious targets for output, quality, cost, and safety.
   

  

 The successful candidate will set the operational agenda, modernize and scale the facility, and embed a culture of excellence that positions the plant as a benchmark in the frozen food sector.
   

  

****Strategic Leadership****
* Define and execute the operational strategy for the facility, aligned with the company's growth ambitions and commercial plans.
* Lead the transformation and modernization of the plant, including capacity expansion, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Translate business objectives into clear operational targets and a roadmap that the wider operations team can deliver against.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to overall business direction and decision\-making.


****Operational Excellence****
* Drive operational excellence across the facility through lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured continuous improvement programs.
* Improve key metrics including OEE, yield, throughput, labor productivity, and waste reduction, with sustained year\-on\-year gains.
* Establish robust planning and scheduling disciplines that ensure on\-time, in\-full delivery against demand.
* Lead root\-cause problem solving and a culture of data\-driven decision making across all shifts and functions.


****Production \& Facility Management****
* Own the full production operation, from raw material intake through processing, freezing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure the reliability and performance of all plant assets, including cold\-chain, freezing, and refrigeration infrastructure, through proactive and preventive maintenance.
* Oversee facility management, utilities, and capital projects to keep the plant running safely and efficiently at all times.


****Quality \& Food Safety****
* Ensure full compliance with all food safety, quality, and regulatory standards, including SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness at all times and uphold the highest standards of hygiene, traceability, and product integrity.
* Build quality and food safety into the culture of the plant, not just the systems.


****People \& Organization****
* Lead, develop, and inspire a large multi\-disciplinary workforce across production, quality, engineering, and supply chain.
* Build organizational capability through hiring, succession planning, training, and performance management.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement at every level.


****Financial \& Commercial****
* Own the facility's operating budget and capital plan, with full P\&L accountability for the cost of operations.
* Drive cost optimization across labor, materials, energy, and overhead without compromising quality or safety.
* Partner closely with commercial, supply chain, and procurement teams to align production with sales, inventory, and service targets.


****Candidate Profile****
* 15\+ years in food manufacturing operations, with significant experience in frozen, chilled, or processed food production.
* Proven track record at Operations Director, Plant Director, or Head of Factory level, leading a full facility at scale.
* Demonstrated success delivering operational excellence, plant transformation, and measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and quality.
* Deep expertise in food safety and quality systems, with hands\-on command of SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP.
* Strong engineering, maintenance, and capital project experience, including cold\-chain and freezing infrastructure.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia, including familiarity with local regulatory requirements, Saudization, and large\-workforce management.
* Engineering, food technology, or operations management degree; postgraduate qualification or lean/Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Exceptional leadership presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build and lead high\-performing teams.


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic and operational leadership
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement
* Food safety and quality governance
* Financial and commercial acumen
* People leadership and organizational development
* Results orientation and accountability

 Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia \& Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low\-carbon energy.
   

  

  

  

 We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.
   

  

  

  

 Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.
   

  

  

  

 To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* **Project Leadership:** 
 Lead and monitor multi\-disciplinary engineering design teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure seamless delivery of comprehensive engineering packages.
* **Scope \& Schedule Management:** 
 Define project scope, develop detailed delivery schedules, and monitor progress against critical paths to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* **Financial Control:** 
 Manage project financial performance, including budgeting, cost estimation, forecasting, and tracking cash flow against milestones.
* **Stakeholder Relations:** 
 Act as the primary focal point for clients, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities, leading regular design reviews and managing change orders effectively.
* **Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify technical and commercial risks early in the design cycle and execute proactive strategies to protect project timelines and margins.
* **HSEQ Compliance:** 
 Ensure all engineering designs and project delivery methods strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality guidelines.


**Qualifications**
* **Experience:** 
 A minimum of
 **5 years of dedicated experience** 
 in engineering project management or design management, preferably within an engineering consultancy, infrastructure, or complex energy sector environment.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related discipline) from an accredited university.
* **Professional Registrations:** 
 Mandatory membership/registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). A Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification is highly desirable.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of standard multi\-disciplinary engineering design workflows, technical documentation cycles, and modern digital engineering platforms (e.g., BIM or CAD systems).
* **Skills \& Competencies:** 
 Exceptional leadership, stakeholder negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing diverse, multi\-cultural engineering teams.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is considered a significant asset.


**Additional Information**

 We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and oversee various energy sector projects, ensuring their successful delivery within scope, budget, and timeline. This role involves managing project teams, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation to achieve project objectives.

* Assemble and lead project teams, providing guidance, motivation, and performance management.
* Communicate regularly with stakeholders, providing project updates, addressing concerns, and managing expectations.
* Identify and manage project risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Manage project budgets, tracking expenditures, and ensuring financial targets are met.
* Oversee procurement processes for project materials and services.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects.
* Prepare and present project reports, presentations, and documentation to senior management and clients.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your background**
* A bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering is required.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in project management, preferably within the energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6\).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and geographically dispersed team environment.
* Proficiency in both spoken \& written in English \& Arabic language is required.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




  





 The Head of Project Execution oversees all aspects of Project Execution within the organization, ensuring that all Airside and Terminal activities comply with the regulations and quality requirements. They provide strategic direction, ensure safety compliance, and facilitate effective communication among Stakeholders ensuring successful project outcomes.
 



  





**Position Accountability Description:** 




  




1. **Strategic Planning and Leadership:** 
 Develop and implement strategic plans and provide strategic direction and leadership for project execution that align with the organization's goals and objectives.
2. Provide leadership and direction to project teams, ensuring a high level of performance and professional development.
3. Monitor industry trends and best practices to ensure the organization's project execution processes remain competitive and effective.



  




1. **Project Management Oversight:** 
 Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of all Airside and Terminal projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget.
2. Ensure the acquisition of necessary permits and clearances for sitework, and compliance with the relevant safety and environmental standards (GACAR, ICAO, FAA etc.).
3. Conduct regular reviews and audits of project documentation, progress reports, and safety records.



  




1. **Team Leadership and Development:** 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the Project Execution team, setting clear performance expectations and providing continuous support.
2. Conduct regular performance reviews and implement development programs to enhance team capabilities.
3. Foster a high\-performing, collaborative, and engaged workforce, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and excellence



  




1. **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Maintain strong relationships with key Stakeholders, including Contractors, Vendors, local Authorities, and community members.
2. Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among project teams and Stakeholders to ensure alignment and address any issues or concerns promptly.
3. Represent the organization in meetings with regulatory bodies, ensuring compliance with Aviation and Environmental standards.



  




1. **Resource Allocation and Financial Management:** 
 Develop and manage the division's budget, ensuring effective allocation and utilization of resources.
2. Identify opportunities for cost savings, value engineering and implement strategies to achieve financial efficiencies.
3. Review and advise on the legitimacy of any potential variation orders.
4. Monitor project expenditures and provide regular financial reports to Senior Management.



  




1. **Risk Management:** 
 Identify and mitigate risks associated with Project Execution, including safety hazards, regulatory compliance, and operational disruptions.
2. Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential risks and ensure business continuity.
3. Ensure that all project activities adhere to the organization's risk management policies and procedures.



  




1. **Performance Monitoring and Reporting:** 
 Develop and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness and efficiency of the project execution division.
2. Provide regular reports and updates to Senior Management on project activities, performance metrics, and strategic initiatives.
3. Conduct regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with project management policies and procedures.



  





**Delegation and Empowerment** 



1. Assign tasks and responsibilities based on team members’ strengths and capabilities, ensuring accountability and empowerment.
2. Empower team members to take ownership of their roles and contribute to project success.



  





**Conflict Resolution** 



1. Address and resolve conflicts within the team or with stakeholders in a constructive manner.
2. Navigate sensitive issues with tact and diplomacy, maintaining positive relationships.



  





  





  





**Minimum Job Requirements:** 




  





 Bachelor’s degree: Engineering or equivalent
 



  





 Minimum 15 years of total experience in Project Management or a similar field within a large organization, preferably in the aviation or transportation industry.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description**
 Mantis is a leading, conservation\-focused hotel group with eco\-lodges, waterways, and curated eco\-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco\-tourism, safaris, and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000\. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach\-side escap,e or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass\-produces sameness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Hawar Resort by Mantis is seeking an experienced and dynamic Culinary Director to lead and oversee all culinary operations across the resort. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining the highest standards of food quality, consistency, innovation, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence across all dining venues. The Culinary Director will play a key role in menu development, talent management, cost control, and culinary innovation while ensuring that all food offerings align with the resort's luxury positioning and guest expectations.
   

  

**What Is In It For You**
* Unleash the excitement: enticing rewards and unbeatable benefits are waiting for you!
* Ignite your skills with our cutting\-edge Academies for rapid professional growth.
* Cultivate your talents and watch your career flourish, locally and globally.
* Drive change through impactful Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
* Immerse yourself in a vibrant work environment with extraordinary colleagues.
* Join us on a direct path to success as we skyrocket to new heights!


**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee all culinary operations across the resort, ensuring alignment with brand standards and operational excellence.
* Lead the development and execution of authentic Italian cuisine concepts, menus, and dining experiences.
* Ensure consistency and the highest standards in food quality, taste, presentation, and temperature across all kitchens.
* Drive innovation in menus, concepts, and food presentation to enhance guest experience and market positioning.
* Collaborate with Marketing and F\&B leadership to develop promotions, campaigns, and destination dining experiences.
* Maintain and improve kitchen operations to maximize profitability while ensuring high guest satisfaction.
* Ensure effective communication and alignment across all culinary teams.
* Monitor and manage stock levels, purchasing, receiving, and storage to meet company standards and control costs.
* Ensure all goods purchased comply with hotel specifications and quality standards.
* Lead and develop culinary teams through training, coaching, succession planning, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP guidelines, hygiene standards, and food safety regulations.
* Promote best practices in kitchen operations, cleanliness, and grooming standards.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships with F\&B, Operations, Sales \& Marketing, and other departments.
* Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements, cost optimization, and operational excellence.
* Stay updated on culinary trends, particularly within Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, and implement relevant innovations.
* Lead by example, fostering a positive, engaged, and high\-performing team culture.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in culinary arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Professional Culinary Certification from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of professional culinary experience, including at least 3 years in a senior culinary leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Italian cuisine, including menu development, authentic preparation methods, and modern Italian dining trends.
* Previous experience in luxury hotels, resorts, or high\-end standalone restaurants.
* Proven track record in menu engineering, food cost control, and operational management.
* Experience managing large culinary teams in a high\-volume environment.
* Strong understanding of international cuisines and dietary requirements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of kitchen management systems, inventory controls, and purchasing procedures.
* Advanced knowledge of food safety standards and HACCP requirements.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience opening or repositioning Italian restaurants within luxury hospitality environments.
* Experience working in island resorts, destination resorts, or luxury lifestyle hospitality brands.
* Strong network within the international culinary community and awareness of emerging food trends.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:** 
 We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
   

  

**Why work for Accor?** 
 We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
   

  

 By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/
   

  

**About Mantis Collection:** 
 Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely\-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco\-tourism in a poverty\-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co\-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.
   

  

 Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo!
 **\#BELIMITLES**

**About Jumeirah**
 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous la responsabilité du Conseil d'administration (CA) de l’Alliance Française (AF) de Manama, et sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement, du bon fonctionnement et du développement de l’Alliance ainsi que du suivi de l’ensemble des actions qui y sont menées, en conformité avec les lois locales. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la Mondialisation, le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances Françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'Alliance Française de Manama accueille 500 à 600 élèves différents par année. L'Alliance est propriétaire de ses locaux, toutefois le foncier demeure la propriété du Ministère bahreïnien des Finances. Elle possède 7 salles de classe équipées en TBI. L’ensemble du parc informatique a été renouvelé, avec connexion internet en fibre optique et 5G. L'AF assure aussi des cours hors de ses locaux (Écoles internationales, dont le Lycée français, Ministères, Universités, personnalités VIP) et cherche à développer les cours hors les murs. Et dispose d'un auditorium de 120 places. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes responsable des missions suivantes: Élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l'établissement ; Mise en place des priorités linguistiques et culturelles définies par l'Ambassade, par la Fondation Alliance française, sous l'autorité du CA de l’AF, de l'Ambassadeur et du COCAC ; Élaboration du budget de l'établissement, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi ; Etablissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays d'affectation ; Représentation de l'Alliance Française en justice et dans tous les actes de la vie civile ; Compte rendu des réalisations et du contexte au Conseiller culturel, à l'Ambassadeur, à la Fondation et à la Direction Générale de la Mondialisation (DGM) du Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères (MEAE).
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Master 2 ou niveau équivalent Expérience d’un milieu associatif et de sa gouvernance (relation CA) Compétences en communication et marketing Expérience avérée en management d’une équipe, direction d’un établissement Expérience de levée de fonds et/ou de mécénats Bonne connaissance du CECR, de la pédagogie par projet et de l’approche actionnelle La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview** 




**AX Coin (a member of AXG) is the first and only licensed stablecoin issuer under the regulation of the Central Bank of Bahrain.** 
 We are seeking an Associate Director of Reserve who will help with all banking, financial institution, and payment rail relationships. The Associate Director of Reserve is responsible for designing and operating the banking, settlement, liquidity, and payment infrastructure that underpins AX Coin’s stablecoin issuance and payments ecosystem. This is a highly execution\-focused role requiring deep understanding of transaction banking, settlement, and regulated payment flows.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.Banking and FI Relationship** 




 Manage strategic relationships with custodian banks and partner financial institutions to ensure the security and efficient operation of reserve custody accounts.
 



**2\.Reserve Composition and Compliance Management** 




 Strictly comply with Chapter 6 of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBB SIO Module to ensure full compliance of reserve assets with respect to ratings, maturities, and currencies. Establish and maintain a 1:1 integrity verification mechanism for reserve assets, and monitor daily to ensure the market value of reserve assets never falls below the total face value of stablecoins in circulation.
 



**3\.Liquidity Management and Stress Testing** 




 Manage asset maturity structures to ensure high liquidity for real\-time minting and redemption demands. Design and execute stress tests under extreme market conditions such as a redemption crunch to ensure the reserve pools resilience.
 



**4\.Yield and Risk Balance** 




 Operate a yield\-bearing stablecoin model within legal and compliance frameworks.
 



**5\.Audit, Reporting and Segregation** 




 Work with accounting firms to complete monthly or quarterly Proof of Reserves audits. Ensure strict physical segregation of reserve assets from corporate operating funds via segregated accounts. Submit reserve asset composition reports to the Central Bank of Bahrain at the required frequency.
 



**6\.Payment Rail and Settlement Architecture** 




 Lead the design, integration, and maintenance of fiat on\-ramp and off\-ramp channels. Establish and manage the connection between settlement accounts and payment partners.
 



**7\.Liquidity Flow Design and Oversight** 




 Define and govern the fiat clearing and settlement mechanisms within the stablecoin minting and redemption processes to ensure efficient and transparent fund movement.
 



**8\.Reconciliation and Operational Coordination** 




 Establish a three\-party reconciliation mechanism among fund flows, asset flows, and on\-chain data to ensure consistency between circulating supply, reserves, and in\-transit funds. Act as the primary point of contact for banking and payment partners to resolve abnormal operational interruptions.
 



**9\.Regional Expansion Support** 




 Support and expand the companys banking and payment capabilities across EMEA Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



**10\.Stakeholder and Partner Management** 




 Work closely with compliance, product, and operations teams to ensure all payment processes and reserve management activities adhere to AML, sanctions screening, and Central Bank of Bahrain regulatory requirements.
 



  





  





**Key Requirements** 




  





**1\.Experience** 



* Industry Experience: 5\+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: payments, transaction banking, treasury management, financial infrastructure; asset management, asset\-liability management ALM, fixed income investment, asset custody; experience supporting regulated financial products or platforms such as stablecoins or electronic money institutions.
* Regional Experience: Experience working with financial institutions, fintechs, or regulatory bodies in Bahrain or the Middle East is preferred.



  





**2\.Professional Skills and Knowledge** 




**Regulatory Knowledge:** 



* Deep understanding of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBBs stablecoin regulatory framework, particularly the SIO Module requirements for eligible reserve assets.
* Familiarity with AML and sanctions screening requirements in the payments space.



**Payments and Settlement:** 



* Strong understanding of payment systems, settlement mechanisms, and liquidity management.
* Hands\-on experience onboarding and maintaining bank partnerships and payment rails.



**Investment and Risk Control:** 



* Familiarity with short\-term fixed income investments and asset\-liability duration matching.
* Capability in liquidity risk modeling and stress testing.



**Reconciliation and Operations:** 



* Ability to design and implement complex multi\-party reconciliation processes on\-chain vs. bank vs. reserves.



**Tools and Certifications:** 



* CFA, FRM, CAIA, or CAMS certification is preferred.



  





**3\.Soft Skills and Attributes** 



* Strong execution discipline, ability to work under pressure, communication and negotiation skills, and compliance sensitivity.



  





**4\.Must have legal authorization to work in Bahrain.**

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with an established Saudi food manufacturer with its own brand in the market to recruit a
 ****National Sales Manager****
 .
   

  

 The business produces and markets branded food products, including meat and frozen food lines, selling across general trade, modern trade, and food service channels throughout the Kingdom and the wider GCC. It goes to market through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and a direct sales team.
   

  

 This opportunity is designed for a national sales leader who will own field sales delivery across the Kingdom, lead regional and channel teams and distributor partners, and drive national sales targets. The role reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The National Sales Manager is responsible for the overall management and performance of the company's sales operation across Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, including sales delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team. Reporting to the Sales \& Marketing Director, the role ensures the implementation of commercially viable sales plans and marketing strategies that maximise returns and deliver customer service excellence. The single most important measure of success in this role is the consistent, profitable achievement of national sales targets.
   

  

 The National Sales Manager leads regional and channel sales teams, manages relationships with distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and works in close coordination with Marketing, Operations, Production, supply chain, and Finance to align sales plans with stock availability, order fulfilment, and collections.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****National sales leadership****
* Supervise, direct, and control sales activities across general trade, modern trade, and food service in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team, ensuring attainment of planned sales targets
* Translate the commercial strategy set by the Sales \& Marketing Director into national, regional, and channel sales plans, targets, and route\-to\-market coverage
* Approve sales plans across product lines and monitor implementation and overall national sales performance
* Drive numeric and weighted distribution, product availability, and visibility across regions and channels
* Continuously track sales results against target, analyse variances, and take timely corrective action


****Planning, policies, and budgets****
* Develop sales work policies, procedures, plans, business budgets, and performance standards in cooperation with distributors, agency representatives, and the Marketing function, for approval by the Director
* Set and communicate KPIs for regional and channel teams, aligned to the national sales plan
* Review and assess the outcomes of market research and promotional campaigns to build effective sales plans and targets inside and outside the Kingdom


****Distributor, agency, and key\-account management****
* Build and manage relationships with sponsored companies, agency representatives, and distributors to ensure coverage, availability, and market penetration
* Negotiate trading terms, targets, and joint business plans with distributors and key retail accounts
* Maintain strong relationships with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers, category managers, and store managers
* Conduct regular market visits to assess product performance and competitor activity at point of sale


****Coordination and operations****
* Liaise on confirmed sales orders, shipping of sold products, stock availability, purchase orders, customer service, and billing
* Coordinate with Finance on collection of payments, billing of key customer accounts, credit control, and the opening of letters of credit to suppliers as required
* Liaise with suppliers, manufacturers, and government agencies on relevant matters and escalate important issues in good time
* Coordinate with supply chain and warehouses to ensure timely, accurate order fulfilment and avoid out\-of\-stock situations


****Reporting and analysis****
* Present periodic sales progress reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director with detailed analysis and recommendations for improvement
* Provide insight on market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and new business opportunities to support decision\-making


****Team leadership****
* Recruit, train, appraise, and motivate a competent national sales team
* Set priorities, assign territories and tasks, and uphold company standards and good conduct
* Build a culture of teamwork, accountability, and customer focus
* Conduct work\-related special assignments as required by the Director


****Authority and Decision\-Making****
* Operates within the company Authority Matrix
* Approves sales plans and monitors sales performance across product lines and regions
* Recommends trading terms and pricing within delegated limits, and credit decisions in line with policy
* Sets priorities and assigns territories and tasks across the sales team
* Conducts performance appraisals and leads recruitment, training, and development of sales staff


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Marketing, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage
* Eight or more years of experience in FMCG sales, including several years in a national or multi\-region sales management role; experience in meat processing or frozen food is strongly preferred
* Proven track record of managing distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and delivering national sales targets across general and modern trade
* Demonstrable track record in sales, business development, or account management with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers
* Professional certifications such as CBDM, PCM, or CSCP are an advantage
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and core tools for sales operations
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English
* Strong leadership, decision\-making, multitasking, and team\-building skills, with a self\-motivated, disciplined, well\-organised, and adaptable personality and the ability to build rapport at all levels
* Willingness to travel across the Kingdom and the wider GCC as required

data.jd_text:
An Insights Manager at CARMA shall lead the end\-to\-end setup, management, and delivery of insight products for one of our most pivotal clients. They shall be responsible for ensuring the quality, clarity, and strategic value of all deliverables, acting as the bridge between the client and our internal teams.
   

  

 The role shall have a dual reporting line to both the Key Account Director as well as Insights Consultant MENA and shall be based on\-site, at the client’s location in Dammam, KSA. This setting supports close collaboration, ongoing knowledge exchange, and the development of strong client relationships.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone genuinely passionate about insights—particularly media insights—who thrives on translating data into meaning, identifying patterns, and helping clients make more informed decisions. The successful candidate will have broad experience delivering media insights across sectors, with the ability to independently produce comprehensive analysis reports that drive actionable outcomes. Active engagement with the wider industry, including familiarity with frameworks like AMEC, is highly valued. While formal qualifications are welcomed, a strong sense of curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning are essential.
   

  

 Insights Managers are expected to manage the expectations of senior stakeholders internally as well as externally and to build strong partnerships with the client, coach and manage secondees based at the client location, and contribute to innovation—especially in integrating AI tools to enhance insight generation and efficiency.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and manage ad\-hoc insight reporting for our Tier 01 client, with on\-site support for their evolving needs.
* Independently develop end\-to\-end analysis reports from the ground up, delivering actionable insights for senior stakeholders and effectively presenting the findings.
* Provide strategic input during key events, crises, and other high\-impact moments
* Manage and oversee the on\-site secondee team to ensure seamless client support and alignment with project goals
* Deliver a comprehensive and scalable measurement programme aligned with client objectives
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with the client
* Leverage AI tools to boost insight generation and improve reporting processes
* Support proposal development, onboarding, and account growth initiatives


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience delivering media insights across industries
* A passion for storytelling through data and evidence
* Strong skills in report writing and analysis, client communication, and project management.
* Familiarity with AMEC frameworks (qualification welcomed but not required)
* A collaborative, curious mindset with a drive to keep learning


**Why join us?**
 Our team is passionate about insights, supportive of each other, and committed to excellence. You’ll be part of a collaborative and growing global team that is shaping the future of communications measurement.
   

  

 Kindly send your CV to careers@carma.com.

 Be part of something exceptional. Be part of our team.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 The Projects Manager will execute fast\-track fit\-out projects for retail stores, F\&B outlets, hotels, and commercial offices. Working independently, he/she will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, and management of multiple projects by leading multi\-disciplinary teams including subcontractors through project activities to meet client requirements and complete projects successfully, safely, within quality, within budget and on\-time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Areas**
 The PM oversees the overall management of projects and client servicing on behalf of the Company, encompassing the following functions:
   

  

**1\-Project Management**
* Review tender programmes and convert them into construction programmes, including defining the client’s direct procurement requirements and client meetings calendar
* Specify project objectives and plans including site set\-up, planning and logistics. Delineation of scope, budgeting, scheduling, setting performance requirements, selection of project sub\-contractors and allocating internal resources (e.g., QA/QC, Health and Safety and MEP Management)
* Set targets for procurement packages and vet sub\-contractors’ tenders
* Decide on purchasing requirements (whether within or outside subcontractors’ remit)
* Ensure projects teams have sufficient resources, equipment, and labour. Plan into order to meet the project timescales and quality requirements
* Attend all site meetings with client and/or consultants as Company representative
* Approve interim payments for subcontractors and their final accounts
* Approve the Company’s interim valuations before submission to our client/consultant
* Liaise and cooperate with in\-house departments such as joinery manufacturing in Bahrain
* Maximise resource efficiency (e.g., labour, materials, and equipment)


**2\-Performance Management**
* Oversee the construction sites and associated site teams, and the management of vendors and trade subcontractors
* Maintain accurate records of construction progress across all projects and report to senior management on a weekly basis
* Ensure good communication between the Company and clients at all times
* Be responsible for health and safety on all sites under his management
* Ensure workers follow Company procedures
* Manage the rectification process on\-time and on\-budget
* Compile and submit Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) manuals to the clients upon project completion
* Manage close out procedure for all projects in accordance with contractual obligations and to high quality standards thereby compelling clients to give a positive review or testimonial


**Candidate Requirements**
* The Projects Manager (PM) should have worked with reputable fit\-out contracting companies in the Middle East for at least 7\-8 years
* Minimum of 10 years’ total work experience in the same field
* Very strong technical, execution and commercial abilities with sound knowledge of the woodworking business particularly the technical aspects relating to joinery and good manufacturing practices of timber, veneers, hardware, etc
* Proven track record as a successful leader at senior management level within the fit\-out industry
* A very good knowledge of latest developments in the fit\-out market. The candidate should be well\-versed with the current trends and news influencing market and be able to suggest ideas to boost the Company’s industry presence and build our brand
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to work successfully in a multinational market environment

data.jd_text:
**Description:** 
 The WADPM shall develop, revise, and maintain an airfield driving program to ensure the safe operations of vehicles, aircraft, and pedestrian movement on and around the airfield environment IAW DAFI 13\-213,
 *Airfield Driving* 
 . The WADPM shall solicit help from base senior leadership and other various base support agencies to ensure the program is effectively implemented and managed. The WADPM shall provide all initial and recurring airfield drivers’ training for all unit level Airfield Driving Program Manager (ADPMs) and all airfield drivers. The WADPM will ensure reporting of Controlled Movement Area Violations and other significant events in Amentum’s MIS system, to appropriate Wing leadership, and as required in DAFMAN 13\-204 and DAFI 13\-213\. The WADPM will conduct spot checks to enforce and monitor compliance with airfield driving procedures.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Must have a \*7\-skill level from an approved DoD institution or civilian equivalent.
* Have documented knowledge or experience with ICAO procedures. Have a minimum of 1 year experience implementing airfield safety procedures and generating and facilitating airfield flight line drivers program.
* Ability to coordinate with Wing Safety, Airfield Management, Airfield Operations, and tenant units.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for program documentation, briefings, and incident reporting.
* Familiarity with airfield operations, ATC radio phraseology, airfield risk management, and airfield safety programs.
* Ability to obtain/maintain a US Secret Clearance (Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain/maintain the clearance)


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Serve as the Wing’s designated Airfield Driving Program Manager, responsible for the full lifecycle of the Airfield Driving Program.
* Develop, maintain, and update the Wing Airfield Driving Instruction (ADI), training and testing materials, and local operating procedures.
* Train unit ADPMs and certify them to administer, test and train personnel assigned to their unit.
* Conduct initial, recurring, and remedial airfield driving training, including classroom instruction, practical evaluations and competency assessments.
* Maintain program records, training logs, violation reports, and certification documentation in accordance with DoD and USAF requirements
* Manage the issuance, tracking, and revocation of Airfield Driving Licenses, ensuring compliance with DAFI 13\-213 and local directives.
* Oversee the Runway Incursion Prevention Program, including trend analysis, corrective actions, and coordination with Wing Safety
* Lead investigations for airfield driving violations, runway incursions, and safety incidents; develop corrective action plans and report findings to Airfield Management leadership.
* Conduct program audits of individual unit programs, spot checks, and unit compliance inspections to ensure adherence to airfield driving standards.
* Provide recurring briefings to Wing leadership on program status, compliance issues, and risk mitigation measures.

data.jd_text:
**Closing Date: 26 June 2026**
 NATS is the UK’s leading air navigation service provider, handling over 2 million flights each year. It provides air traffic control services, as well as a wide range of commercial solutions to over 30 countries internationally. Our people are at the heart of our purpose to advance aviation and keep the skies safe.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 This role is accountable for the day\-to\-day operational oversight, training and implementation of ANS solutions across the contract. The role is responsible for providing advice and support within the operations directorate, ensuring independent oversight that delivers assurance that operational and training responsibilities, as well as quality standards, are being met, maintained, and continually improved in relation to the contract’s operational service delivery in Kuwait.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, acting as the point of contact for all operational and training matters.
* Understand client needs, challenges, and objectives to deliver the contract and drive customer satisfaction.
* Provide oversight on all operational activities to meet or outperform all operational and safety KPIs.
* Work closely with the regulator to ensure all policies, procedures and training programmes comply with regulatory requirements and company policies.
* Manage operational and training budgets and forecasts, tracking performance against targets and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Provide regular updates to clients on operational KPIs, training status, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring transparency and alignment on expectations.
* Work closely with the Delivery Director to ensure that up to date account reviews and performance reports are in place for internal stakeholders and senior management.
* Analyse day\-to\-day operations and processes and identify areas for process enhancement.
* Develop an implementation plan to introduce a Search and Rescue cell responsible for all Search and Rescue activities required in the Kuwait FIR.


**Qualifications, Skills And Personal Attributes**
* Extensive experience in ATC Supervisory or Management roles, with a detailed understanding of the operational environment and the critical role that people and processes play in achieving operational KPIs and meeting training objectives.
* Excellent leadership skills, with steadfast resolve and personal integrity.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Preferably possess experience in Search and Rescue (SAR) operations, including familiarity with SAR procedures, coordination protocols, emergency response frameworks and collaboration with multi‑agency teams.
* A University Degree is strongly preferred for this role.
* Fluent in English


**Additional Vacancy Information**
* Required to work flexibly across different time zones and working weeks.
* International travel as required.


 We are proud to offer a fantastic total reward package to help you thrive both personally and professionally. In addition to a competitive salary that's regularly reviewed, as a member of our international team, you'll also benefit from private healthcare and dental cover, a generous leave entitlement with the option to purchase additional leave, wellness support and a comprehensive learning and development offering. For more information, please visit International \- NATS
   

  

 If you share our passion to advance aviation and keep the skies safe – we would like to hear from you whatever your age, sex, race, faith, visible or invisible disability. Individuals that bring different perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds help us be at the forefront of our industry.

 Iron Mountain is seeking a
 **skilled** 
**Solutions Delivery Architect (SDA)** 
 to join our
 **Professional Services**

You will partner with Solution Architects to validate standardized designs, mentor functional architects and business analysts, and ensure the integrity of the solution throughout the implementation process.
 



  





 You will collaborate closely with peers in the technical pre\-sales community, the global Enterprise Architecture team, and regional operations, serving as the trusted solution design partner for our customers.

 In this role, you will:

 all aspects of the post\-sale design journey, from requirements validation through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), acceptance, and handover, ensuring the design covers functional, non\-functional, security, and operational requirements.

 solution integrity is maintained by assessing and authorizing any design changes during implementation, and partner with the global Enterprise Architecture team to develop and apply standard reference architectures and design patterns.

 The ideal candidate will have:

 to support work–life balance.

 .

 .



  





  





 If you possess the technical gravitas and architectural vision to lead the design of complex digital solutions, apply now to become a Solutions Delivery Architect at Iron Mountain.

data.jd_text:
Can you lead commercial strategy for complex field developments — and maximize asset value?
   

  

 Are you able to drive integration across technical and commercial teams to deliver full‑cycle project success?
   

  

**Be part of a successful team!**
 Baker Hughes Integrated Services exist to
 **plan, manage, and execute multi‑disciplinary well and field development projects** 
 through a single accountable team. Their mandate is to deliver predictable outcomes, optimize asset value, and reduce operational risk for operators.
   

  

**Fuel your passion**
 The
 **Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development** 
 is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
   

  

 This position requires strong E\&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end\-to\-end technical development plans into fit\-for\-purpose commercial structures.
   

  

**As an Integrated Commercial Director \- Field Development, you will be responsible for:**
* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client\-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end\-to\-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long\-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development\-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E\&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.


**To be successful in this role you will:**
* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10\+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E\&P business development function.
* Have 10\+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end\-to\-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, contractual risk, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve complex problems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs, projects, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation skills with experience managing complex customer discussions and commercial agreements.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Director \- Proposals
   

  

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
   

  

 Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.raw_snippet: We are seeking an experienced Information Technology Manager to lead the organization's technology function and drive its digital transformation agenda. This role is responsible for developing and executing the IT strategy, ensuring the security, reliability, and efficiency of technology infrastruct
data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced Information Technology Manager to lead the organization's technology function and drive its digital transformation agenda. This role is responsible for developing and executing the IT strategy, ensuring the security, reliability, and efficiency of technology infrastructure, and enabling business growth through innovative technology solutions.
 



 The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of IT operations, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, infrastructure, vendor management, and IT governance while serving as a strategic partner to business leaders across the organization.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**IT Strategy \& Digital Transformation** 



* Develop and implement the organization's short\- and long\-term IT strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that support organizational growth and innovation.
* Establish IT governance frameworks, standards, policies, and best practices.



**IT Infrastructure \& Operations** 



* Direct and oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the organization's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, telecommunications, databases, and end\-user computing.
* Ensure the availability, reliability, scalability, and performance of all technology systems and services.
* Manage system upgrades, migrations, implementations, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Oversee disaster recovery planning, business continuity processes, and data backup strategies.
* Monitor IT service delivery and implement continuous improvement initiatives.



**Information Security \& Risk Management** 



* Act as the organization's Information Security Lead, ensuring the implementation and maintenance of effective cybersecurity controls.
* Develop and enforce information security policies, procedures, and compliance standards.
* Identify technology\-related risks and implement mitigation strategies to safeguard organizational assets and data.
* Ensure adherence to cybersecurity best practices and regulatory requirements.



**Enterprise Applications \& Systems Management** 



* Lead the management, enhancement, and support of enterprise business applications, including ERP systems and related platforms.
* Oversee system integrations, database management, reporting tools, and application performance optimization.
* Collaborate with business units to identify system requirements and deliver technology solutions that support operational needs.
* Ensure data integrity, system efficiency, and user satisfaction across all business applications.



**Leadership \& People Management** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing IT team.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Conduct performance evaluations and identify development opportunities for team members
* Ensure adequate resource planning and succession development within the department.



**Vendor \& Contract Management** 



* Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and consultants.
* Lead contract negotiations, service\-level agreements, renewals, and vendor performance reviews.
* Evaluate technology investments and ensure maximum return on investment.



**Budgeting \& Performance Management** 



* Develop and manage the annual IT budget, ensuring cost\-effective allocation of resources.
* Monitor departmental expenditures and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Prepare management reports, performance dashboards, and strategic recommendations.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure IT effectiveness and service quality.



**Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Partner with business leaders to understand operational challenges and identify technology\-driven solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on technology\-related matters across the organization.
* Ensure IT initiatives are aligned with business priorities and strategic objectives.



**Additional Responsibilities** 



* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Deputy General Manager – Corporate Support.
* Participate in strategic projects and cross\-functional initiatives as required.



  





**Qualifications**



* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Master's Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline is an advantage.
* Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, CISM, CCNA, MCSE, SAP, Microsoft, Oracle, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.



  





**Experience**



* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Information Technology.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role.
* Proven experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, business applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience with ERP systems, database management, systems integration, and vendor management.
* Experience in large\-scale or multi\-site operations is preferred.

 Sous l'autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) / Directrice de l'Institut français du Koweït (IFK) et en lien avec l’agence comptable régionale (ACR) et le secrétariat général d'ambassade (SGA), vous occupez les fonctions de secrétaire général (SG) d’un établissement à autonomie financière (EAF) en organisant le fonctionnement et la gestion administrative, matérielle, juridique, budgétaire et financière de l’Institut Français du Koweït qui dispose d’une personnalité juridique locale. Vous gérez également les crédits du service de coopération et d'action culturelle (SCAC) et proposez un appui ponctuel à l’Institut français de recherche à l’étranger, le Centre français de Recherche de la péninsule arabique à Koweït (CEFREPA).
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 Sous l'autorité du COCAC/Directeur, vous êtes responsable des affaires générales, des questions budgétaires, comptables et administratives, du management des ressources humaines, de la gestion immobilière, logistique, matérielle et de la sécurité. Vos missions principales sont les suivantes : 1\. Contribution au pilotage : \- mise en œuvre du plan de redynamisation de l’activité et de redressement financier de l’institut ; \- présentation des résultats et performances ; \- réalisation d'études de rentabilité et analyses prospectives ; \- accompagnement du directeur dans sa politique de mécénat et sponsoring ; \- réflexion sur les trajectoire financière, rationalisation des moyens et diversification des ressources. 2\. Gestion financière et budgétaire : \- préparation et exécution du budget, élaboration des budgets rectificatifs, mise en place d’outils d’optimisation de gestion, analyse des comptes budgétaires et suivi des tableaux de bord ; \- interface avec le ministère (DGM/DDC/RES, tutelle de l'IF) pour le contrôle de gestion et le rapport d’activités ; \- suivi du Contrôle interne financier (CIF) avec l'ACR. Le SG est membre du comité de gouvernance. 3\. Gestion des ressources humaines : \- coordination et encadrement des personnels, suivi de l’organigramme fonctionnel (ADL, expatriés), plannings, congés ; \- gestion administrative des personnels (recrutement, déroulement de carrière, contrats, évaluation, ...) ; \- suivi, application de la législation locale du travail, en lien avec l’avocat conseil du poste ; \- animation du dialogue social, relations avec les représentants du personnel et délégués syndicaux, gestion des conflits ; \- mise en place de formations ; \- suivi des questions d'hygiène, de sécurité et de conditions de travail. 4\. Gestion administrative : \- pilotage administratif et juridique (contrôle des conventions, veille juridique, gestion du contentieux ; \- suivi des contrats et conventions signés par chaque antenne, supervision des procédures administratives ; \- rédaction des notes de service, rappel des instructions, coordination des moyens et des ressources, conventions de prestation, contrat de location des locaux, rédaction de contrats avec les artistes, gestion et accueil des artistes en tournée, contact avec les fournisseurs) ; \- contrôle des activités de l'ensemble des services : réorganisation des procédures, limitation du risque de vol/fraude (en particulier au niveau du centre de langues, de l'espace Campus France, de la médiathèque) ; \- mise à jour du guide d’accueil, du règlement intérieur ; \- suivi de l'inventaire et de l'archivage. 5\. Gestion logistique, matérielle et immobilière : \- gestion du bâti et de l'investissement (travaux et commande) ; \- veille à la mise à jour régulière du plan de sécurité des emprises ; \- relations avec le propriétaire ; \- négociation et suivi des contrats de maintenance ; \- gestion des risques et veille à l'application des consignes de sécurité ; \- mise à jour du règlement intérieur de sécurité.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Pour les agents du MEAE : BAACA option encadrement. Connaissance indispensable de la DGM, de son organisation, de ses procédures, de ses outils et mécanismes de financement. Expérience réussie dans des fonctions similaires au sein d’un Institut Français, notamment en management, ainsi qu'en suivi budgétaire/gestion des ressources humaines d’un établissement cultuel. Sans être indispensable, de même que la connaissance de la région, la maîtrise de la langue locale constituerait un atout.
